items.title: 美光罷工危機解除、外銷訂單連20紅、公股投信四合一拍板 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Micron Strike Crisis Resolved, Export Orders Rise for 20 Consecutive Months, State-Owned Asset Managers Approve Four‑Way Merger – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美光台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，罷工危機解除；經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷統計，受惠AI需求強勁，9月外銷訂單金額達1142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，連20紅；第一金控、兆豐金控、合庫金控與華南金控等4家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過4家投信子公司整併案，以下為本周大事回顧：

美光台中工會協商成功！8成人員調薪近2.7倍 經部盼桃園廠跟進 

美光(MICR-US)台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，約8成以上人員調薪近2.7倍，產線人員年薪提高至200多萬元，初階與中高階工程師年薪更分別上看400萬與600萬元，勞退提撥亦升至10%。經濟部周四(22日)晚間表示樂見雙方達成共識，並期盼桃園廠能持續溝通，共同創造雙贏。

〈外銷訂單〉連20紅！9月1142億美元年增62% 全年可望破兆美元 

經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷訂單統計，受惠於AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新品陸續上市帶動拉貨動能，9月外銷訂單金額高達1,142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，較上月大幅增加112.5億美元或10.9%，與去年同月相比更爆增438.7億美元，年增率攀升至62.4%。8、9月更是連續2個月衝破千億美元大關，刷新連續20個月正成長紀錄。

四大公股投信整併案拍板！第一金控持股50.3% 第一金投信存續 

第一金控(2892-TW)、兆豐金控(2886-TW)、合庫金控(5880-TW)及華南金控(2880-TW)等四家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過四家投信子公司整併案，本整併案由資產管理規模最大、經營績效較佳的第一金投信擔任存續公司。

〈財委會質詢〉台股巨震步入熊市？彭金隆：尊重市場機制 暫無限空令等措施 

近期台股波動加劇，引發市場對「熊市」的擔憂，周一(19日)立法院財政委員會高度關注政府監理工具與當沖降稅政策。金管會主委彭金隆強調，監理機關首重尊重市場機制，目前交易秩序仍屬理性，暫無實施限空或禁空等人工干預措施；針對 2027 年底到期的當沖降稅優惠，金管會規劃於明年 2、3 月召開公聽會廣徵各界意見，再行定奪。

〈力積電法說〉Q4營收估季增雙位數 明年成熟製程代工價格再漲10-20% 

力積電(6770-TW)周三(21)日召開法說，經營團隊表示，受惠記憶體供需持續吃緊、邏輯晶圓代工價格調漲，以及3D AI Foundry相關產品逐步恢復出貨，預期第四季營收可望季增雙位數；明年在AI需求動能不減下，對營收及獲利表現抱持期待，成熟製程代工價格規劃再調漲10%至20%，並積極與客戶協商長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前綁定明年價量。

是方中科虎尾AI資料中心挑戰預約率8至9成 目標2031年獲利 

是方(6561-TW)中科虎尾AI資料中心周二(20日)舉辦動土典禮，總經理劉耀元指出，是方中科虎尾AI資料中心將於2028年下半年啟用商轉，挑戰預約率達8至9成，目標在2031年開始獲利。
paras_en: Micron's Taichung union and the company reached a labor agreement, ending the strike crisis; the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Tuesday (the 20th) released September export statistics, showing that strong AI demand lifted September export order value to $114.21 billion, a historic monthly high and the 20th consecutive month of growth; the boards of four state‑owned financial holding companies – First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding, Cooperative Financial Holding and Hua Nan Financial Holding – and their respective asset‑management subsidiaries – First Financial Asset Management, Mega International Asset Management, Cooperative Bank Asset Management and Hua Nan Yongchang Asset Management – each approved the merger of the four asset‑management units on Thursday (the 22nd). This is the weekly recap of major events.

Micron (MICR‑US) Taichung union successfully negotiated! About 80% of staff received salary hikes of roughly 2.7 times, raising line workers' annual pay to over NT$2 million, while junior and senior engineers now earn about NT$4 million and NT$6 million respectively; retirement contributions were also increased to 10%. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said on Thursday evening that it welcomed the consensus and hopes the Taoyuan plant will continue talks to create a win‑win outcome.

Export orders posted a 20‑month winning streak! September’s $114.21 billion in orders represented a 62% year‑over‑year increase and is expected to push total 2024 exports past the trillion‑dollar mark. The surge was driven by robust AI, high‑performance computing and cloud‑service demand, plus new consumer‑electronics launches that boosted shipments. September’s figure was up $11.25 billion (10.9%) from August and $43.87 billion (62.4%) higher than the same month last year, marking the second consecutive month above $100 billion and extending a 20‑month growth streak.

Four state‑owned asset‑management merger approved! First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) will hold a 50.3% stake and First Financial Asset Management will continue as the surviving entity. The boards of First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), Cooperative Financial Holding (5880‑TW) and Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW), together with their asset‑management subsidiaries, voted on Thursday (the 22nd) to merge the four units, with the largest and best‑performing First Financial Asset Management designated as the surviving company.

Financial Committee questioning: Is Taiwan’s stock market entering a bear market? Peng Jin‑long says respect market mechanisms, no short‑selling bans for now. Recent heightened volatility in Taiwan’s stock market has sparked bear‑market concerns. On Monday (the 19th), the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee closely examined government supervisory tools and the day‑trading tax‑reduction policy. Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin‑long emphasized that regulators must respect market mechanisms; trading remains orderly and there are no plans to impose short‑selling limits or bans. Regarding the day‑trading tax‑reduction incentive that expires at the end of 2027, the FSC will hold public hearings in February‑March next year to gather opinions before deciding.

Powerchip (6770‑TW) Q4 earnings forecast: double‑digit quarterly growth; mature‑process foundry prices to rise another 10‑20% next year. At its Wednesday (the 21st) earnings briefing, management said tight memory supply‑demand, higher logic‑wafer foundry prices and the gradual recovery of 3D AI Foundry product shipments should drive double‑digit quarterly revenue growth in Q4. Looking ahead to next year, with AI demand remaining strong, the company expects continued revenue and profit upside and plans a further 10%‑20% price increase for mature‑process foundry services, while actively negotiating long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to lock in volume and pricing.

IsFong (6561‑TW) launches groundbreaking ceremony for its Zhongke Huwei AI data center. General manager Liu Yao‑yuan said the facility, slated for commercial operation in the second half of 2028, aims for an 80%‑90% reservation rate and targets profitability starting in 2031.

items.title: 馬斯克終極野心：打造科技「全棧帝國」從衛星、電力到晶片與機器人 拿下AI產業命脈
items.title_en: Musk's Ultimate Ambition: Building a Full‑Stack Tech Empire from Satellites, Power, Chips to Robots, Seizing the AI Industry's Lifeblood
paras: 馬斯克正加速打造橫跨衛星通訊、太空運輸、人工智慧 (AI) 算力、能源、晶片及機器人的垂直整合科技帝國。隨著SpaceX第三季營收大幅成長、AI運算基礎設施快速擴張，以及特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 與SpaceX可能合併的討論浮上檯面，馬斯克的終極布局逐漸清晰：從衛星傳輸、電力供應、晶片與AI模型，到機器人及終端設備，盡可能將AI產業鏈的關鍵環節掌握在同一個企業體系內。
SpaceX第三季營收達146億美元，年增161%，比華爾街預期高出逾20億美元，並首次實現正的營業利益。財務長Bret Johnsen預估，2027年第一季營收可望達330億至370億美元，且年度化經常性營收將在今年12月前突破1,000億美元。馬斯克也證實，SpaceX與特斯拉的獨立董事特別委員會正在討論兩家公司合併的可能性。
若合併成真，SpaceX將結合火箭發射、全球衛星通訊、AI運算與能源供應，以及特斯拉的汽車製造、自動駕駛、能源儲存和Optimus人形機器人業務，形成涵蓋太空、地面及數位世界的科技平台。這不僅是企業規模的擴張，更是馬斯克試圖控制AI產業核心基礎設施的長期戰略。
SpaceX旗下Starlink衛星網路已成為這套布局的重要起點。第三季Starlink新增160萬名用戶，總訂戶數達1,360萬人。相較之下，美國電信商威瑞森 (Verizon) (VZ-US) 擁有約1.47億個無線連線，AT&T (T-US) 約有1.1億個無線連線，但Starlink的成長速度相當突出。
Starlink訂戶數從2023年底的230萬人，增加至2024年底的440萬人，2025年底進一步升至890萬人，2026年前三季又新增470萬人。單看第三季，AT&T僅新增37.9萬名後付費用戶，威瑞森則新增18.4萬名，顯示衛星通訊服務正以不同於傳統電信業者的方式擴張。
Starlink在航空市場的滲透也持續增加，目前約有1.2萬架商用飛機採用其服務。航空公司之間的網路服務差異，可能因此成為競爭變數之一。報導指出，美國聯合航空已採用Starlink服務，達美航空則尚未導入。
除了衛星寬頻，SpaceX也正透過Starlink Mobile切入行動通訊市場。這項服務無須架設屋頂天線，而是透過T-Mobile (TMUS-US) 等合作電信商，讓一般手機直接連接衛星。Starlink Mobile每月活躍用戶已達2,200萬人，第三季成長37%。
SpaceX近期另與EchoStar (SATS-US) 達成協議，計畫以約170億美元收購無線頻譜，並預計於2028年初推出完整的行動電信服務。若計畫順利推進，SpaceX將不再只是向電信業者提供衛星連線能力，也有機會直接進入行動通訊服務市場。
在衛星技術方面，SpaceX新一代V3衛星的單顆下載容量可達每秒1太比特 (Tbps)，理論上可同時支援約20萬條影片串流。每枚Starship星艦火箭可搭載60顆這類衛星。2026年9月進行的第14次星艦飛行，單次部署所對應的頻寬達每秒26太比特，超過衛訊公司 (Viasat) (VSAT-US) 整個ViaSat-3衛星星系容量的8倍。
研究機構TeleGeography估計，截至2026年年中，全球國際網路總容量約為每秒2,259太比特，主要仰賴海底電纜。SpaceX計畫在2027年將星艦發射頻率提高至每週一次，長期目標則是每天發射。若發射頻率、衛星部署與網路容量持續提升，Starlink的全球傳輸規模將進一步擴大，並可能對傳統海底電纜與地面網路形成新的競爭壓力。
然而，馬斯克的野心並不止於傳輸網路。他也正積極擴大SpaceX的AI運算能力，試圖成為全球最重要的算力供應商之一。報導指出，SpaceX目前每月約有22萬顆輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) GB300晶片投入運作，馬斯克表示，明年還將加快部署速度。
根據鴻海相關披露，SpaceX已向鴻海下訂約93.6萬顆GB300晶片，訂單價值約520億美元，交付期限延伸至2027年第一季。業界估計，輝達今年Blackwell系列晶片總產量約550萬至600萬顆，SpaceX的採購量約占其中40%，使其成為輝達目前最大的單一客戶。
SpaceX已在美國田納西州孟菲斯建成Colossus 2資料中心，報導將其描述為全球最大的AI資料中心，但這仍只是整體擴張計畫的一部分。SpaceX的算力截至2026年9月底已達1.7吉瓦 (GW)，預計10月底接近2吉瓦，12月底進一步升至2.5至3吉瓦。
到了2027年第二季，SpaceX計畫啟動一座配備44萬顆輝達下一代Vera Rubin晶片的訓練叢集，並將每年新增10吉瓦算力列為目標。馬斯克對此表示高度信心，甚至認為實際新增規模不太可能低於13吉瓦。
外部企業對SpaceX算力的需求同樣可觀。AI公司Anthropic已承諾在2029年前向SpaceX租用價值約845億美元的算力；Alphabet旗下Google則同意自2026年10月至2029年6月，每月向SpaceX支付9.2億美元購買算力。
值得注意的是，Google本身具備自研晶片與大型運算叢集，但仍選擇向SpaceX採購算力，反映AI產業目前面臨的瓶頸不只是晶片供應，更包括資料中心所需的電力與基礎設施。當大型AI模型訓練和推論需求快速成長，能夠同時掌握晶片、電力及資料中心的企業，將有機會取得更大的議價能力。
電力供應因此成為馬斯克布局中不可或缺的一環。美國通用電氣維諾瓦 (GE Vernova) (GEV-US) 是美國資料中心燃氣渦輪機的重要供應商之一，但其訂單已排滿至2030年。報導指出，該公司待交付訂單達116吉瓦，年度產能卻僅約20吉瓦，顯示資料中心電力設備供應存在明顯限制。
為降低對外部供應商的依賴，SpaceX選擇自行建設發電系統。公司已在密西西比州Southaven建成自有發電設施，配置41部燃氣渦輪機，裝置容量達1.2吉瓦；另向韓國斗山重工採購5部容量各為380兆瓦的設備。
馬斯克表示，SpaceX的能源技術具有高度專有性，其優勢來自火箭引擎製造所累積的先進鑄造能力，可自行製造燃氣渦輪機葉片，將電力設施部署時間縮短12至18個月。
SpaceX計畫在2027年建置20吉瓦的發電與冷卻設施，以確保算力擴張不受電力限制。報導估計，若公司在2027年底前實現20吉瓦燃氣渦輪機裝置容量，每日天然氣消耗量可能達30億至45億立方英尺，相當於美國能源資訊署預估2027年全年美國天然氣產量增量中的大部分。
不過，快速擴張也帶來龐大的資金壓力。SpaceX第三季營業活動現金流約96億美元，資本支出卻高達196億美元，因此自由現金流約為負100億美元。財務長Johnsen更預估，第四季資本支出將達350億至400億美元，約為投資人先前預期的兩倍。
與大型雲端服務商相比，SpaceX的資本支出強度尤其突出。報導估計，亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 今年每取得1美元營收，約投入0.27美元於資本支出，微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US) 與Alphabet也處於相近水準；SpaceX的資本支出與營收比率則約為2.50倍，相當於亞馬遜的9倍左右。
截至2026年9月底，SpaceX持有899億美元現金及短期投資，負債為388億美元。第三季EBITDA約88億美元，年化約350億美元。目前負債約為年化EBITDA的1倍，低於標普全球 (S&P Global) 對投資等級企業通常維持的2倍上限。
儘管現有資產負債結構仍保有一定空間，若SpaceX要完成10吉瓦算力建設並維持投資等級信用評等，仍可能需要額外融資。潛在方式包括增發股票、由輝達等供應商提供晶片融資，或向客戶收取預付款。
報導引述的標普全球預測指出，SpaceX借款規模可能在2028年達到1,320億美元，自由現金流則可能直到2030年才轉正。換言之，馬斯克正在以龐大資本投入，提前搶占未來AI算力市場，但投資回收速度仍將取決於企業需求、算力租賃價格與基礎設施建設進度。
特斯拉與SpaceX合併的構想，則可能成為這套垂直整合體系的最後一塊拼圖。馬斯克已確認，兩家公司獨立董事組成的特別委員會正在討論合併方案，但目前仍屬評估階段，尚未代表交易已經敲定。
若合併完成，SpaceX將取得特斯拉的工廠、自動駕駛技術及Optimus人形機器人業務，並有機會將AI算力直接應用於車輛運作與工廠生產。Starlink衛星可提供自動駕駛車輛、機器人及其他自主系統所需的通訊連線，特斯拉的電池與能源儲存技術則可能支援SpaceX日益增加的資料中心用電需求。
雙方已推進的合作計畫Terafab，正是整合晶片與AI運算的重要項目，目標是生產特斯拉自動駕駛車輛、Optimus機器人，以及SpaceX AI與資料中心所需的先進晶片，馬斯克希望在2028年底前啟動量產。
特斯拉的大規模工廠自動化經驗，也可能協助SpaceX提高星艦的工業化生產效率；SpaceX的火箭技術則可能進一步應用於特斯拉未來產品。兩家公司合併後，也有機會整合電池、半導體、製造設備、推進系統、衛星硬體與特殊金屬等供應鏈。
從產業結構來看，馬斯克的策略是將AI所需的晶片、電力、傳輸、運算模型與實體終端設備盡可能納入同一體系。當AI運算成本愈來愈取決於晶片、電力與資料傳輸效率，能夠控制多個環節的企業，便可能在各個層級取得利潤，並降低對外部供應商的依賴。
不過，合併也伴隨治理、監管及執行風險。SpaceX是美國軍方、情報機構及NASA的重要承包商，特斯拉則與中國市場及上海工廠有深度連結。兩家公司若合併，可能面臨更嚴格的美國國安審查、中國監管關注，以及股東對利益衝突、投票權與資本配置的疑慮。
此外，星艦、無人計程車、人形機器人、AI資料中心、行動通訊及軌道運算設施，都是成本高昂且技術挑戰極大的計畫。將這些業務整合在同一家公司，並不會消除技術風險，只是讓它們集中於同一個企業架構之下。
從營收規模來看，報導預估SpaceX在2027年底前，單季營收有機會超過500億美元，接近2025年第三季56億美元的9倍。這項預測能否實現，仍取決於AI算力需求是否持續成長，以及SpaceX能否將晶片、電力、衛星與資料中心建設轉化為穩定的商業收入。
馬斯克打造科技帝國的核心，不再只是製造更便宜的電動車或發射更多火箭，而是將AI時代最關鍵的基礎設施整合起來。從Starlink的全球通訊、SpaceX的算力與自建能源，到特斯拉的汽車、工廠及機器人，這套布局試圖建立一個從太空延伸至地面的完整技術生態系。但在營收高速成長的另一面，龐大資本支出、融資需求與多項高風險技術計畫，也將成為這場長期投資能否成功的關鍵考驗。
paras_en: Musk is accelerating the creation of a vertically integrated tech empire that spans satellite communications, space transport, artificial‑intelligence (AI) compute, energy, chips and robots. With SpaceX’s Q3 revenue soaring, AI compute infrastructure expanding rapidly, and talks of a possible Tesla (TSLA‑US)‑SpaceX merger surfacing, Musk’s ultimate layout is becoming clearer: from satellite transmission, power supply, chips and AI models to robots and end‑devices, he aims to keep the key links of the AI value chain within a single corporate system.

SpaceX reported Q3 revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year‑over‑year, more than $2 billion above Wall Street expectations, and posted its first positive operating profit. CFO Bret Johnsen projects Q1 2027 revenue of $33‑$37 billion, with annualized recurring revenue expected to exceed $100 billion by December 2024. Musk also confirmed that a special committee of independent directors at Tesla is discussing a possible merger with SpaceX.

If a merger materializes, SpaceX would combine rocket launches, global satellite communications, AI compute and power supply with Tesla’s car manufacturing, autonomous driving, energy storage and Optimus humanoid‑robot businesses, forming a tech platform that spans space, ground and digital realms. This is not merely a scale expansion but a long‑term strategy for Musk to control the core infrastructure of the AI industry.

SpaceX’s Starlink satellite network is a cornerstone of this plan. In Q3, Starlink added 1.6 million new users, bringing total subscriptions to 13.6 million. By comparison, U.S. telecoms Verizon (VZ‑US) and AT&T (T‑US) have roughly 147 million and 110 million wireless connections respectively, but Starlink’s growth rate is strikingly high.

Starlink’s subscriber base grew from 2.3 million at the end of 2023 to 4.4 million at the end of 2024 and is projected to reach 8.9 million by the end of 2025, with an additional 4.7 million added in the first three quarters of 2026. In Q3 alone, AT&T added only 379,000 post‑paid customers while Verizon added 184,000, underscoring how satellite service is expanding in a manner distinct from traditional telcos.

Starlink’s penetration of the aviation market is also rising, now serving about 12,000 commercial aircraft. Differences in in‑flight connectivity could become a competitive factor; United Airlines has adopted Starlink, while Delta has not yet done so.

Beyond satellite broadband, SpaceX is entering the mobile market with Starlink Mobile, which requires no rooftop antenna and connects directly to satellites via partners such as T‑Mobile (TMUS‑US). Starlink Mobile now has 22 million monthly active users, up 37% in Q3.

SpaceX recently struck a deal with EchoStar (SATS‑US) to acquire roughly $17 billion of wireless spectrum, with plans to launch a full‑service mobile telecom operation in early 2028. If successful, SpaceX would move from merely providing satellite backhaul to becoming a direct mobile‑service provider.

Technologically, SpaceX’s next‑gen V3 satellites can download up to 1 terabit per second (Tbps) per unit, theoretically supporting about 200,000 simultaneous video streams. Each Starship launch can carry 60 of these satellites. The 14th Starship flight in September 2026 deployed bandwidth of 26 Tbps, eight times the total capacity of Viasat’s (VSAT‑US) ViaSat‑3 constellation.

Research firm TeleGeography estimates global international‑network capacity at about 2,259 Tbps as of mid‑2026, largely reliant on submarine cables. SpaceX aims to increase Starship launch cadence to once per week in 2027, with a long‑term goal of daily launches. Continued growth in launch rate, satellite deployment and network capacity would expand Starlink’s global transport scale and pressure traditional submarine‑cable and terrestrial networks.

Musk’s ambitions extend beyond connectivity. He is aggressively scaling SpaceX’s AI compute capability to become one of the world’s premier compute providers. Reports indicate SpaceX currently runs roughly 220,000 NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GB300 chips each month, with plans to accelerate deployment next year.

According to disclosures from Foxconn, SpaceX has ordered 936,000 GB300 chips from the contract manufacturer, a deal worth about $52 billion, with deliveries stretched to Q1 2027. Industry estimates place NVIDIA’s annual Blackwell output at 5.5‑6 million chips, meaning SpaceX’s order represents roughly 40% of production, making it NVIDIA’s largest single customer today.

SpaceX has built the Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, Tennessee, touted as the world’s largest AI data center, though it is only part of a broader expansion plan. By the end of September 2026, SpaceX’s compute capacity reached 1.7 GW, expected to approach 2 GW by October and rise to 2.5‑3 GW by year‑end.

By Q2 2027, SpaceX plans to launch a training cluster equipped with 440,000 next‑generation NVIDIA Vera Rubin chips, targeting an annual addition of 10 GW of compute. Musk is confident the actual increase could exceed 13 GW.

External demand for SpaceX compute is also sizable. AI firm Anthropic has pledged to lease about $84.5 billion of compute from SpaceX through 2029, while Google, under Alphabet, agreed to pay $920 million per month for SpaceX compute from October 2026 through June 2029.

Google already develops its own chips and massive compute clusters, yet it still opts to buy compute from SpaceX, highlighting that AI bottlenecks now involve not only chip supply but also power and data‑center infrastructure. As large‑model training and inference demand accelerates, firms that control chips, electricity and facilities gain stronger bargaining power.

Power supply is therefore a critical piece of Musk’s puzzle. GE Vernova (GEV‑US), a major supplier of gas turbines for U.S. data centers, has its order book filled through 2030. The company has pending orders totaling 116 GW, yet its annual production capacity is only about 20 GW, indicating a clear supply constraint for data‑center power equipment.

To reduce reliance on external vendors, SpaceX is building its own power generation. It has installed a private plant in Southaven, Mississippi, with 41 gas turbines delivering 1.2 GW of capacity, and has ordered five 380‑MW units from South Korea’s Doosan Heavy Industries.

Musk says SpaceX’s energy technology is highly proprietary, leveraging advanced casting capabilities honed in rocket‑engine manufacturing to produce turbine blades in‑house, cutting deployment time for power assets by 12‑18 months.

SpaceX plans to build 20 GW of generation and cooling capacity by 2027 to ensure compute expansion is not power‑constrained. Analysts estimate that achieving 20 GW of gas‑turbine capacity by year‑end 2027 could require daily natural‑gas consumption of 3‑4.5 billion cubic feet, roughly the bulk of the incremental U.S. gas production projected by the EIA for 2027.

Rapid expansion, however, brings heavy capital pressure. SpaceX’s Q3 operating cash flow was about $9.6 billion, while capital expenditures topped $19.6 billion, yielding a free‑cash‑flow deficit of roughly $10 billion. CFO Johnsen forecasts Q4 capex of $35‑$40 billion, about twice what investors had anticipated.

Compared with major cloud providers, SpaceX’s capex intensity is extreme. Amazon (AMZN‑US) spends roughly $0.27 of capex for every $1 of revenue this year; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Alphabet are similar. SpaceX’s capex‑to‑revenue ratio is about 2.5×, roughly nine times Amazon’s level.

As of September 2026, SpaceX held $89.9 billion in cash and short‑term investments against $38.8 billion of debt. Q3 EBITDA was about $8.8 billion, annualized to roughly $35 billion. Debt now equals about one times annualized EBITDA, well below the 2× ceiling typical for investment‑grade issuers per S&P Global.

While the current balance sheet still offers headroom, completing a 10 GW compute build‑out and maintaining an investment‑grade rating may still require additional financing. Options include equity raises, chip‑financing from suppliers like NVIDIA, or taking advance payments from customers.

S&P Global forecasts SpaceX’s borrowings could reach $132 billion by 2028, with free cash flow not turning positive until 2030. In other words, Musk is pouring massive capital into the future AI‑compute market, but the pay‑back timeline will hinge on customer demand, compute‑rental pricing and infrastructure rollout speed.

The Tesla‑SpaceX merger concept could be the final piece of this vertical integration. Musk confirmed a special committee of independent directors from both companies is evaluating a merger, but it remains in the assessment stage and does not yet represent a finalized deal.

If merged, SpaceX would acquire Tesla’s factories, autonomous‑driving technology and Optimus robot business, and could apply AI compute directly to vehicle operation and factory production. Starlink could supply the communications link needed for autonomous cars, robots and other autonomous systems, while Tesla’s batteries and energy‑storage tech could meet SpaceX’s growing data‑center power needs.

The joint “Terafab” effort already underway is a key chip‑and‑AI‑compute integration project, aimed at producing advanced chips for Tesla’s self‑driving cars, Optimus robots and SpaceX’s AI and data‑center workloads, with mass production targeted for the end of 2028.

Tesla’s large‑scale factory automation expertise could help SpaceX improve Starship’s industrial production efficiency; conversely, SpaceX’s rocket technology could find applications in future Tesla products. Post‑merger, the combined entity could integrate supply chains for batteries, semiconductors, manufacturing equipment, propulsion systems, satellite hardware and specialty metals.

From an industry‑structure perspective, Musk’s strategy is to bring the chips, power, transmission, compute models and physical end‑devices required for AI into a single ecosystem. As AI compute costs become increasingly tied to chip efficiency, electricity and data‑transfer performance, firms that control multiple layers can capture profit at each level and reduce dependence on outside suppliers.

However, a merger also brings governance, regulatory and execution risks. SpaceX is a major contractor for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and NASA, while Tesla has deep ties to the Chinese market and its Shanghai plant. A combined company could face stricter U.S. national‑security reviews, heightened Chinese regulatory scrutiny, and shareholder concerns over conflicts of interest, voting rights and capital allocation.

Moreover, Starship, autonomous taxis, humanoid robots, AI data centers, mobile communications and orbital compute facilities are all capital‑intensive, technically demanding projects. Consolidating them under one roof does not eliminate technical risk; it merely concentrates those risks within a single corporate structure.

In revenue terms, analysts project SpaceX could see quarterly revenue exceed $50 billion by the end of 2027, nearly nine times its Q3 2025 level of $5.6 billion. Whether that forecast materializes will depend on sustained AI‑compute demand and SpaceX’s ability to turn chip, power, satellite and data‑center builds into stable commercial revenue streams.

Musk’s core ambition in building a tech empire is no longer just about cheaper electric cars or more rockets, but about integrating the most critical infrastructure of the AI era. From Starlink’s global communications and SpaceX’s compute and self‑built power to Tesla’s vehicles, factories and robots, the plan seeks to create a full‑stack technology ecosystem that stretches from space to the ground. Yet alongside rapid revenue growth, massive capex, financing needs and a suite of high‑risk technical programs will determine whether this long‑term investment can succeed.

items.title: AI基建風暴升溫！新雲端業者全線重挫、信用風險攀升、Solidigm撤回IPO
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Storm Intensifies! New Cloud Players Plunge, Credit Risks Rise, Solidigm Pulls IPO
paras: AI基礎建設投資本週經歷動盪的一週。《CNBC》報導，新型雲端業者（Neocloud）股價重挫，信用違約交換（CDS）利差飆升，Meta(META-US)自由現金流轉為負值，南韓SK海力士(SK Hynix)旗下Solidigm也取消IPO計畫。
那斯達克指數週四遭遇重挫後，週五(23日)進一步下跌，整週收低0.7%。在超大規模雲端服務商（Hyperscalers）之中，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)表現最差，股價下跌6%，市場正等待這家網路巨頭下週公布第三季財報。微軟(MSFT-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)也將公布財報，兩家公司股價則各自下跌不到1%。
儘管科技股市場迄今尚未出現全面性大規模拋售，AI基礎建設投資熱潮卻已開始顯露壓力。
新雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)及IREN(IREN-US)本週全線重挫，10月以來跌幅均已遠超過30%。其中，規模領先的CoreWeave，其CDS利差已擴大至11%以上，通常被視為陷入財務困境的警訊，反映投資人為防範違約風險而必須支付更高成本。CoreWeave於2031年及2032年到期的無擔保債券殖利率也突破15%。
Roundhill Investments執行長Dave Mazza週四受訪表示，「投資人現在的做法，是把所有人都一併打入冷宮，認為任何新雲端業者都將遭到重新估值、股價下修。」
市場疑慮也不僅限於美國。南韓雲端服務商Elice Group週二上市首日股價下跌30%，澳洲資料中心營運商NextDC(NXT-AU)週三暴跌39.5%，因公司大幅下修全年獲利預測。
過去幾年，市場對AI的樂觀情緒一直是推動股市的重要力量。隨著市場對新模型與AI服務的需求持續攀升，全球最大型科技公司以歷史罕見規模投入基礎建設。然而，愈來愈多懷疑論者開始質疑，AI投資的回報是否足以支撐龐大的資本支出。
研究機構Gartner分析師預測，到2030年，80%新型雲端業者將停止營運，或被其他公司併購。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳或許是AI最積極支持者之一，他仍對產業前景保持樂觀。黃仁勳本週在柏林舉行的GTC大會中表示，「市場對新型雲端業者的需求高得驚人」。
黃仁勳接受CNBC訪問時談到，「資金需求遠遠超過目前可取得的資金規模，這個問題終究會獲得解決。」

Solidigm撤回IPO計畫

華爾街對AI投資熱潮的信心卻沒有那麼堅定。南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士(SKHY-US)是AI熱潮主要受惠者之一，但公司週四宣布，因市場波動而撤回旗下美國子公司Solidigm的IPO計畫。Solidigm主要為資料中心生產NAND快閃記憶體與固態硬碟（SSD），SK海力士於2021年向英特爾(INTC-US)收購該業務。
SK海力士在聲明中表示，「原本預期透過IPO減輕投資負擔，並擴大股東報酬能力，但考量市場狀況與股價走勢後，公司決定停止相關評估。」
儘管市場動盪，科技業大型權值股目前仍維持投資級信用評等，即使它們為了推進AI基礎建設而大舉投入資金，並透過發債等方式籌措資金，市場仍開始出現不安情緒。
Meta第三季自由現金流轉負，金額超過20億美元。公司同時將全年資本支出預測下限從1,300億美元提高至1,350億美元，導致股價週四重挫7%。Meta還表示，未來數年在各類租賃與合約上的支出約達8,250億美元，其中逾4,500億美元的租賃合約屬於不可取消的「照付不議」（take-or-pay）協議。
Meta五年期CDS利差升至歷史新高，突破124個基點。輝達與甲骨文(ORCL-US)的CDS利差本週也創下紀錄，分別達到126個基點與343個基點。甲骨文今年已下跌超過三分之一，如今還面臨信用評等遭下調的風險。
律師事務所Milbank LLP衍生性金融商品業務主管John Williams表示，投資人正尋求多種風險避險方式，不再只是透過買進CDS來降低AI投資曝險。
Williams指出，「投入這個領域的資金實在太多了，因此尋找風險管理工具非常合理，無論你看多還是看空都一樣。不去尋找合適的風險管理工具，反而不明智。」
Equity Armor Investments投資組合經理人Brian Stutland上週受訪時，談到AI對整體市場的影響，表示各環節「其實全都環環相扣」。
他指出，「你能把一顆保齡球丟進泳池的一端，卻確保下游的那斯達克其他部分完全不會受到波及嗎？我不知道，但這確實讓我有些擔憂。」
paras_en: AI infrastructure investments experienced a turbulent week. CNBC reported that new cloud provider Neocloud saw its stock tumble, credit default swap (CDS) spreads surge, Meta (META-US) turned its free cash flow negative, and SK Hynix's Solidigm in South Korea cancelled its IPO plan.

After the Nasdaq index suffered a sharp drop on Thursday, it fell further on Friday (the 23rd), closing the week down 0.7%. Among the hyperscalers, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) performed the worst, sliding 6% as the market awaits the internet giant’s Q3 earnings next week. Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Amazon (AMZN-US) also have earnings due, with their shares each slipping less than 1%.
Although the tech‑stock market has not yet seen a broad, massive sell‑off, the AI infrastructure investment boom is already showing signs of strain.

New cloud players CoreWeave (CRWV-US), Nebius (NBIS-US) and IREN (IREN-US) all plunged this week, each down more than 30% since October. The leading CoreWeave saw its CDS spread widen to over 11%, a typical warning sign of financial distress, reflecting investors’ need to pay higher costs to hedge default risk. CoreWeave’s unsecured bonds maturing in 2031 and 2032 also saw yields break 15%.

Roundhill Investments CEO Dave Mazza told reporters on Thursday that “investors are now treating everyone the same, shoving all new cloud players into the cold aisle, assuming they will all be re‑valuated and see their stock prices cut.”

Market concerns are not limited to the United States. South Korean cloud provider Elice Group saw its shares fall 30% on the first day of trading on Tuesday, while Australian data‑center operator NextDC (NXT-AU) plunged 39.5% on Wednesday after the company sharply cut its full‑year profit outlook.

In recent years, optimism about AI has been a key driver of equity markets. As demand for new models and AI services keeps climbing, the world’s largest tech firms are investing in infrastructure at historically unprecedented scales. Yet an increasing number of skeptics are questioning whether AI returns can justify the massive capital outlays.
Gartner analysts forecast that by 2030, 80% of new cloud providers will either cease operations or be acquired by other companies.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang may be one of AI’s most vocal champions, and he remains upbeat about the industry’s prospects. Huang said at the GTC conference in Berlin this week that “the market’s demand for new cloud providers is astonishingly high.”
In a CNBC interview, Huang added, “Funding needs far exceed the amount of capital currently available; this problem will eventually be solved.”

Solidigm Pulls IPO Plan
Wall Street’s confidence in the AI investment frenzy is less firm. South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US), a major beneficiary of the AI boom, announced on Thursday that it is withdrawing the IPO plan for its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm due to market volatility. Solidigm manufactures NAND flash memory and SSDs for data centers; SK Hynix acquired the business from Intel (INTC-US) in 2021.

In its statement, SK Hynix said, “We originally expected the IPO to ease investment burdens and expand shareholder returns, but after considering market conditions and stock performance, the company has decided to halt the evaluation.”

Despite the market turbulence, large‑cap tech stocks still retain investment‑grade credit ratings. Even as they pour massive capital into AI infrastructure and raise funds through bond issuances, market unease is beginning to surface.

Meta’s Q3 free cash flow turned negative, exceeding $2 billion. The company also raised the lower end of its full‑year capital‑expenditure forecast from $130 billion to $135 billion, sending the stock down 7% on Thursday. Meta also disclosed that over the next few years it expects about $825 billion in lease and contract spend, more than $450 billion of which are non‑cancellable take‑or‑pay agreements.

Meta’s five‑year CDS spread hit a historic high, breaking 124 basis points. Nvidia’s and Oracle’s (ORCL-US) CDS spreads also set weekly records at 126 and 343 basis points respectively. Oracle has already fallen more than a third this year and now faces the risk of a credit‑rating downgrade.
Milbank LLP derivatives head John Williams said investors are seeking multiple hedging strategies, no longer relying solely on buying CDS to reduce AI‑investment exposure.

Williams noted, “The amount of capital flowing into this sector is enormous, so looking for risk‑management tools is entirely reasonable, whether you’re bullish or bearish. Not seeking appropriate risk‑mitigation tools would be unwise.”
Brian Stutland, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, said in an interview last week that the impact of AI on the overall market is “really interconnected at every link.”
He added, “Can you throw a bowling ball into one end of a swimming pool and be sure the downstream parts of the Nasdaq won’t be affected? I don’t know, but it does worry me.”

items.title: 美特使稱最快週末攻擊伊朗 以色列宣布封鎖西岸、中東多線升溫
items.title_en: US Envoy Says Attack on Iran Possible This Weekend; Israel Announces West Bank Blockade, Middle East Tensions Rise
paras: 美國最快本週末再度攻擊伊朗？美國駐土耳其大使、兼任總統敘利亞及伊拉克特使的巴拉克 (Tom Barrack) 表示，美方「絕對有可能」在本週末發動攻擊。不過，美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 被問及這番說法時，卻表示自己毫不知情，讓華府下一步軍事動向更受關注。
巴拉克在週五於網路流傳的專訪片段中，被問到美方是否可能在本週末攻擊伊朗時，回答：「本週末有可能發動攻擊嗎？絕對有可能。」
巴拉克強調，川普政府對伊朗的目標並非推翻政權，而是降低區域與國際安全威脅。川普希望重新調整局勢，化解人質問題、消除威脅，讓全球局勢恢復平靜。
他也指出，川普仍願意與德黑蘭達成協議，對協商抱持開放態度，「但他同時也非常清楚地表明自己想要什麼」。
記者隨後向川普詢問巴拉克的說法，並追問他是否改變原先等到 11 月 3 日期中選舉後才考慮動武的立場。
川普一開始似乎感到意外，反問：「那是我的大使說的？」
川普接著說：「看來他是個相當有權勢的人。嗯，如果是這樣，我對此一無所知。」他並未證實美方是否準備在週末採取軍事行動。
然而，川普週五在佛羅里達州造勢時，也未排除再次攻擊伊朗，同時表示美國「可能再來一次小規模的『史詩怒火』行動」，但未進一步說明。「史詩怒火」是美軍對伊朗軍事行動使用的名稱。
面對美方可能再度動武，伊朗革命衛隊政治局負責人賈瓦尼 (Yadollah Javani) 則發出警告。
他表示，若外國部隊發動地面入侵，伊朗將成為入侵者的「墳場」，並聲稱美軍在區域內已面臨部署限制，難以進入陌生地形並維持駐軍。
美伊戰爭自 2 月底爆發至今已近 8 個月，荷姆茲海峽成為雙方角力焦點。
伊朗攻擊船舶與能源設施，加上美國封鎖伊朗港口，已干擾全球油氣供應；燃料價格上漲，也在美國期中選舉前加重川普的政治壓力。
與此同時，中東其他戰線持續升溫。約旦河西岸希伯崙週五發生槍戰，以軍表示，2 名以色列士兵死亡、3 人受傷，2 名巴勒斯坦槍手隨後遭擊斃。
以色列總理尼坦雅胡宣布將全面封鎖西岸，並稱以軍已準備展開「大規模行動」。
以軍稍後則表示，已在巴勒斯坦希伯崙地區展開範圍有限、具針對性的安全行動，預計持續數日。當地多處道路及出入口遭封閉，學校、大學停課，交通服務暫停。
葉門方面，沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍表示，已攔截青年運動 (胡塞組織) 朝沙國南部城市海米斯穆謝特發射的一枚彈道飛彈。沙國支持的葉門政府軍也聲稱，已空襲塔伊茲一處胡塞組織指揮據點。
為避免衝突進一步擴大，埃及、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其及巴基斯坦外長在伊斯坦堡會談後發表聯合聲明，強調應透過對話與外交處理美國、以色列對伊朗的戰爭，反對限制合法航行的措施，並呼籲全面恢復荷姆茲海峽安全通航。
paras_en: US may attack Iran again as early as this weekend? Tom Barrack, the US ambassador to Turkey who also serves as President’s special envoy to Syria and Iraq, said the US "absolutely could" launch an attack this weekend. However, when asked about the remark on Friday the 23rd, President Trump said he was unaware, drawing even more attention to Washington’s next military move.

In a widely circulated online interview clip on Friday, Barrack was asked whether the US might attack Iran this weekend, to which he replied, "Is an attack possible this weekend? Absolutely possible."

Barrack emphasized that the Trump administration’s goal toward Iran is not regime change but reducing regional and global security threats. Trump wants to reset the situation, resolve hostage issues, eliminate threats, and restore global stability.
He also noted that Trump remains willing to reach an agreement with Tehran and is open to negotiations, "but he also makes very clear what he wants."
Reporters then asked Trump about Barrack’s statement and whether he had changed his earlier stance of waiting until after the November 3 midterm elections before considering military action.
Trump initially seemed surprised and asked, "Did my ambassador say that?"
Trump went on, "He seems to be a very powerful person. Well, if that’s the case, I know nothing about it." He did not confirm whether the US was preparing a weekend military operation.

Nevertheless, Trump did not rule out another strike on Iran while campaigning in Florida on Friday, saying the US could launch another small‑scale "Epic Fury" operation, but gave no further details. "Epic Fury" is the name the US military uses for actions against Iran.
In response to the possibility of renewed US force, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard political bureau chief Yadollah Javani issued a warning.

He said that if foreign forces launch a ground invasion, Iran would become a "graveyard" for the invaders, and claimed US forces in the region face deployment limits, making it hard to operate in unfamiliar terrain and maintain a presence.
The US‑Iran war, which erupted at the end of February, has now lasted nearly eight months, with the Strait of Hormuz becoming the focal point of the contest.

Iran’s attacks on ships and energy facilities, combined with US blockades of Iranian ports, have disrupted global oil and gas supplies; rising fuel prices are adding political pressure on Trump ahead of the midterm elections.

Meanwhile, other fronts in the Middle East continue to heat up. A gunfight broke out in Hebron in the West Bank on Friday, with the Israeli army reporting two Israeli soldiers killed, three wounded, and two Palestinian gunmen later killed.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced a total blockade of the West Bank, saying the Israeli forces are ready to launch a "large‑scale operation."

The Israeli army later said it had begun a limited, targeted security operation in the Hebron area of the Palestinian territories, expected to last several days. Multiple roads and entry points were closed, schools and universities suspended classes, and transport services were halted.

In Yemen, the Saudi‑led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthi movement toward the southern Yemeni city of Hami‑Smuchet. Yemen’s government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, also claimed to have air‑striked a Houthi command post in Taiz.

To prevent further escalation, the foreign ministers of Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan issued a joint statement after meeting in Istanbul, emphasizing that the US‑Israel war against Iran should be addressed through dialogue and diplomacy, opposing measures that restrict lawful navigation, and calling for the full restoration of safe shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉安克生醫安克呼止偵獲美國聯邦醫療保險支付 周漲近2成
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Anke Biotech’s Anke Respiration Detector Secures Medicare Reimbursement, Stock Rises Nearly 20% in a Week
paras: 安克生醫(4188-TW)旗下安克呼止偵於美國史丹佛睡眠醫學中心成功獲得聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)支付檢測費用，並持續拓展海外市場，激勵安克生醫股價漲勢凌厲，單周大漲近2成。
安克生醫本周漲19.1%，周四(22日)亮燈漲停，收17.15元，站上所有均線。三大法人也連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超227張。
安克呼止偵以非侵入式超音波結合AI分析，10分鐘可完成阻塞型睡眠呼吸中止症(OSA)風險篩檢。自2019年起合作的美國史丹佛睡眠醫學中心，已逐步將產品導入臨床流程，應用從篩檢延伸至治療評估與轉介，並透過既有醫療處置代碼，成功獲得美國聯邦醫療保險(Medicare)支付檢測費用，為拓展美國市場建立重要實例。
另外，安克呼止偵也已完成土耳其設備出貨及臨床導入，杜拜據點持續生成應用，並洽談英國市場合作，推進設備銷售與軟體訂閱服務。
安克甲狀偵方面，已獲全台超過30家醫療院所採用，預計第四季向相關專家提出健保暫時性支付HTR計畫，推進後續收集真實世界數據。國際上，安克與 CARPL、deepc及SECTRA等醫療影像平台推動技術整合與合作洽談，期望透過平台的醫院網絡，加速產品拓展海外市場。
paras_en: Anke Biotech (4188‑TW) announced that its Anke Respiration Detector has successfully obtained Medicare reimbursement for testing fees at Stanford Sleep Medicine Center in the United States, and the company continues to expand overseas markets, driving a sharp rise in Anke Biotech’s share price, which jumped almost 20% in a single week.

The stock rose 19.1% this week; on Thursday (the 22nd) it hit the daily limit up, closing at NT$17.15 and moving above all moving averages. The three major institutional investors bought net shares for three consecutive trading days, totaling a net purchase of 227 lots this week.

The Anke Respiration Detector uses non‑invasive ultrasound combined with AI analysis to complete a 10‑minute screening for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) risk. Since 2019, the Stanford Sleep Medicine Center in the United States has gradually integrated the product into clinical workflows, extending its use from screening to treatment assessment and referral, and by leveraging existing medical procedure codes, it has successfully secured Medicare reimbursement for the test, providing a key case for expanding into the U.S. market.

In addition, the Anke Respiration Detector has completed equipment shipments and clinical rollout in Turkey, its Dubai hub continues to generate applications, and talks are underway for cooperation in the United Kingdom to advance equipment sales and software subscription services.

Regarding Anke’s thyroid detector, it has already been adopted by more than 30 medical institutions across Taiwan, and a temporary National Health Insurance reimbursement (HTR) plan is expected to be submitted to relevant experts in Q4 to facilitate further real‑world data collection. Internationally, Anke is pursuing technology integration and cooperation with medical imaging platforms such as CARPL, deepc and SECTRA, hoping to accelerate overseas product expansion through the platforms’ hospital networks.

items.title: 美光罷工危機解除、外銷訂單連20紅、公股投信四合一拍板 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Micron Strike Crisis Resolved, Export Orders Rise for 20 Consecutive Months, State-Owned Asset Managers Approve Four‑Way Merger – Weekly Highlights
paras: 美光台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，罷工危機解除；經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷統計，受惠AI需求強勁，9月外銷訂單金額達1142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，連20紅；第一金控、兆豐金控、合庫金控與華南金控等4家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過4家投信子公司整併案，以下為本周大事回顧：

美光台中工會協商成功！8成人員調薪近2.7倍 經部盼桃園廠跟進 

美光(MICR-US)台中工會與公司達成勞資協議，約8成以上人員調薪近2.7倍，產線人員年薪提高至200多萬元，初階與中高階工程師年薪更分別上看400萬與600萬元，勞退提撥亦升至10%。經濟部周四(22日)晚間表示樂見雙方達成共識，並期盼桃園廠能持續溝通，共同創造雙贏。

〈外銷訂單〉連20紅！9月1142億美元年增62% 全年可望破兆美元 

經濟部周二(20日)公布9月外銷訂單統計，受惠於AI、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新品陸續上市帶動拉貨動能，9月外銷訂單金額高達1,142.1億美元，創歷史單月新高，較上月大幅增加112.5億美元或10.9%，與去年同月相比更爆增438.7億美元，年增率攀升至62.4%。8、9月更是連續2個月衝破千億美元大關，刷新連續20個月正成長紀錄。

四大公股投信整併案拍板！第一金控持股50.3% 第一金投信存續 

第一金控(2892-TW)、兆豐金控(2886-TW)、合庫金控(5880-TW)及華南金控(2880-TW)等四家公股金控董事會及旗下投信子公司第一金投信、兆豐國際投信、合作金庫投信及華南永昌投信等四家董事會，分別於周四(22日)通過四家投信子公司整併案，本整併案由資產管理規模最大、經營績效較佳的第一金投信擔任存續公司。

〈財委會質詢〉台股巨震步入熊市？彭金隆：尊重市場機制 暫無限空令等措施 

近期台股波動加劇，引發市場對「熊市」的擔憂，周一(19日)立法院財政委員會高度關注政府監理工具與當沖降稅政策。金管會主委彭金隆強調，監理機關首重尊重市場機制，目前交易秩序仍屬理性，暫無實施限空或禁空等人工干預措施；針對 2027 年底到期的當沖降稅優惠，金管會規劃於明年 2、3 月召開公聽會廣徵各界意見，再行定奪。

〈力積電法說〉Q4營收估季增雙位數 明年成熟製程代工價格再漲10-20% 

力積電(6770-TW)周三(21)日召開法說，經營團隊表示，受惠記憶體供需持續吃緊、邏輯晶圓代工價格調漲，以及3D AI Foundry相關產品逐步恢復出貨，預期第四季營收可望季增雙位數；明年在AI需求動能不減下，對營收及獲利表現抱持期待，成熟製程代工價格規劃再調漲10%至20%，並積極與客戶協商長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前綁定明年價量。

是方中科虎尾AI資料中心挑戰預約率8至9成 目標2031年獲利 

是方(6561-TW)中科虎尾AI資料中心周二(20日)舉辦動土典禮，總經理劉耀元指出，是方中科虎尾AI資料中心將於2028年下半年啟用商轉，挑戰預約率達8至9成，目標在2031年開始獲利。
paras_en: Micron's Taichung union and the company reached a labor agreement, ending the strike crisis; the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Tuesday (the 20th) released September export statistics, showing that strong AI demand lifted September export order value to $114.21 billion, a historic monthly high and the 20th consecutive month of growth; the boards of four state‑owned financial holding companies – First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding, Cooperative Financial Holding and Hua Nan Financial Holding – and their respective asset‑management subsidiaries – First Financial Asset Management, Mega International Asset Management, Cooperative Bank Asset Management and Hua Nan Yongchang Asset Management – each approved the merger of the four asset‑management units on Thursday (the 22nd). This is the weekly recap of major events.

Micron (MICR‑US) Taichung union successfully negotiated! About 80% of staff received salary hikes of roughly 2.7 times, raising line workers' annual pay to over NT$2 million, while junior and senior engineers now earn about NT$4 million and NT$6 million respectively; retirement contributions were also increased to 10%. The Ministry of Economic Affairs said on Thursday evening that it welcomed the consensus and hopes the Taoyuan plant will continue talks to create a win‑win outcome.

Export orders posted a 20‑month winning streak! September’s $114.21 billion in orders represented a 62% year‑over‑year increase and is expected to push total 2024 exports past the trillion‑dollar mark. The surge was driven by robust AI, high‑performance computing and cloud‑service demand, plus new consumer‑electronics launches that boosted shipments. September’s figure was up $11.25 billion (10.9%) from August and $43.87 billion (62.4%) higher than the same month last year, marking the second consecutive month above $100 billion and extending a 20‑month growth streak.

Four state‑owned asset‑management merger approved! First Financial Holding (2892‑TW) will hold a 50.3% stake and First Financial Asset Management will continue as the surviving entity. The boards of First Financial Holding, Mega Financial Holding (2886‑TW), Cooperative Financial Holding (5880‑TW) and Hua Nan Financial Holding (2880‑TW), together with their asset‑management subsidiaries, voted on Thursday (the 22nd) to merge the four units, with the largest and best‑performing First Financial Asset Management designated as the surviving company.

Financial Committee questioning: Is Taiwan’s stock market entering a bear market? Peng Jin‑long says respect market mechanisms, no short‑selling bans for now. Recent heightened volatility in Taiwan’s stock market has sparked bear‑market concerns. On Monday (the 19th), the Legislative Yuan’s Finance Committee closely examined government supervisory tools and the day‑trading tax‑reduction policy. Financial Supervisory Commission Chairman Peng Jin‑long emphasized that regulators must respect market mechanisms; trading remains orderly and there are no plans to impose short‑selling limits or bans. Regarding the day‑trading tax‑reduction incentive that expires at the end of 2027, the FSC will hold public hearings in February‑March next year to gather opinions before deciding.

Powerchip (6770‑TW) Q4 earnings forecast: double‑digit quarterly growth; mature‑process foundry prices to rise another 10‑20% next year. At its Wednesday (the 21st) earnings briefing, management said tight memory supply‑demand, higher logic‑wafer foundry prices and the gradual recovery of 3D AI Foundry product shipments should drive double‑digit quarterly revenue growth in Q4. Looking ahead to next year, with AI demand remaining strong, the company expects continued revenue and profit upside and plans a further 10%‑20% price increase for mature‑process foundry services, while actively negotiating long‑term supply agreements (LTA) to lock in volume and pricing.

IsFong (6561‑TW) launches groundbreaking ceremony for its Zhongke Huwei AI data center. General manager Liu Yao‑yuan said the facility, slated for commercial operation in the second half of 2028, aims for an 80%‑90% reservation rate and targets profitability starting in 2031.

items.title: 鴻海斥12.03億美元 增資新加坡、法國及捷克子公司
items.title_en: Foxconn Spends $1.203 Billion to Capital‑Increase Singapore, France and Czech Subsidiaries
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)今(23)日公告，董事會通過對新加坡、法國及捷克子公司進行增資，交易金額分別為11.01億美元、5,800萬美元及4,400萬美元，合計斥資12.03億美元，作為長期投資用途。
鴻海公告指出，將對新加坡子公司eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd.進行現金增資，認購普通股11.01億股，每股價格1美元，交易總金額11.01億美元。增資後，鴻海累計持有該公司19.13億股，持股比例達100%。
此外，鴻海也將對法國子公司Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS增資5,800萬美元，取得約510.07萬股，每股價格10歐元。增資後，鴻海累計持股數為510.07萬股，持股比例達100%。
在捷克方面，鴻海將對子公司Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o.增資4,400萬美元，約當9.44億捷克克朗。公告顯示，鴻海累計持有該公司股權金額為9.44億捷克克朗，持股比例90.42%；另由Foxconn Holdings B.V.持有1億捷克克朗，持股比例9.58%。
鴻海表示，上述三筆投資均以長期投資為目的，相關增資案均經董事會決議通過。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) announced today (23) that its board approved capital increases for subsidiaries in Singapore, France and the Czech Republic, with transaction amounts of $1.101 billion, $58 million and $44 million respectively, totaling $1.203 billion, for long‑term investment purposes.

Foxconn said it will make a cash capital increase in its Singapore subsidiary eCMMS Precision Singapore Pte. Ltd., subscribing for 1.101 billion ordinary shares at $1 per share, for a total of $1.101 billion. After the increase, Foxconn will hold a cumulative 1.913 billion shares, representing 100% ownership.

In addition, Foxconn will increase capital in its French subsidiary Foxconn AI Solution (FR) SAS by $58 million, acquiring about 5.1007 million shares at €10 per share. After the increase, Foxconn’s cumulative holding will be 5.1007 million shares, representing 100% ownership.

In the Czech Republic, Foxconn will increase capital in its subsidiary Foxconn European Manufacturing Services s.r.o. by $44 million, equivalent to CZK 944 million. The announcement shows Foxconn’s cumulative equity in the company is CZK 944 million, representing a 90.42% stake; Foxconn Holdings B.V. holds CZK 100 million, a 9.58% stake.
Foxconn said all three investments are for long‑term purposes and the capital increase plans have been approved by the board.

items.title: 〈工業生產指數〉連31紅！工業與製造業生產指數雙創新高 估10月續紅
items.title_en: Industrial Production Index Extends 31-Month Growth Streak; Both Industrial and Manufacturing Indices Hit Record Highs, October Expected to Remain Positive
paras: 受惠於人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算及雲端資料服務等應用需求持續熱絡，加上消費性電子新品備貨潮挹注，經濟部於今（23）日公布最新統計數據，9月工業生產指數為 140.76，較上年同月增加 19.17%；其中製造業生產指數達 143.31，年增 20.21%。兩大指數皆創下歷年同月新高，雙雙寫下連續 31 個月正成長紀錄。 展望10月，在AI與年終旺季帶動下，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
累計今年前 9 個月來看，工業生產指數為 133.10，較上年同期增加 20.53%；製造業生產指數則為 135.48，年增 21.83%，展現出台灣科技製造業強韌的成長動能。
深入分析各產業表現，資訊電子工業成為推升本月指數創高的絕對主力，年增率高達 27.42%。其中：
電子零組件業： 9月年增 23.62%，主因受惠高效能運算與 AI 應用需求維持強勁，伴隨消費性電子新品備貨，帶動 12 吋晶圓代工、IC 封測、記憶體、IC 設計及載板等產品生產成長，累計前 9 月較上年同期增加 21.07%。
電腦電子產品及光學製品業： 隨著 AI 應用與雲端服務蓬勃發展，促使全球雲端服務大廠加速布建 AI 基礎設施，加以半導體設備投資動能續強，推升伺服器、半導體檢測設備及零組件、交換器、固態硬碟等產品生產大幅成長，年增率高達 45.92%，累計前 9 月更大增 80.05%。
在傳統產業方面，受惠於半導體業者持續擴產以及 AI 供應鏈的外溢需求，部分產業同步展現增產態勢：
機械設備業： 年增 26.02%，主因半導體廠持續拓展先進製程與高階封測產能，帶動電子與半導體生產用設備及零組件、機械傳動設備等產量擴增，外加工具機訂單續增所致。
基本金屬業與汽車零組件業： 基本金屬業年增 1.39%，主因市場需求緩步回溫，熱軋鋼捲板與靶材等產品生產增加；汽車及其零件業則因市場需求增溫及電動車政策加持，年增 2.35%。
化學材料及肥料業： 則因部分產品市場回溫力道仍緩，年減 4.29%（惟拋光矽晶圓受惠半導體需求持續增產）。

展望未來，經濟部指出，雖然全球經濟成長動能仍受到地緣政治及貿易政策等不確定性因素影響，但受惠於 AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等新興科技應用需求持續擴增，全球雲端大廠積極投資 AI 基礎設施，將有助於延續我國半導體先進製程、高階封裝及伺服器等相關供應鏈的生產動能。再加上年終消費旺季的備貨需求陸續湧現，預期將可有效支撐我國製造業生產維持穩健成長態勢。綜合研判，估 10 月製造業生產指數 141.56 至 145.86，年增 20.5% 至年增 24.2%。
paras_en: Benefiting from sustained demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high‑performance computing and cloud data services, as well as a surge in inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, the Ministry of Economic Affairs released the latest statistics on the 23rd. September’s industrial production index was 140.76, up 19.17% year‑on‑year; the manufacturing production index reached 143.31, up 20.21% YoY. Both indices set new monthly records and marked the 31st consecutive month of growth. Looking ahead to October, driven by AI and the year‑end peak season, the manufacturing production index is projected to range from 141.56 to 145.86, representing a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

Cumulatively for the first nine months of this year, the industrial production index stood at 133.10, 20.53% higher than the same period last year; the manufacturing production index was 135.48, up 21.83% YoY, showcasing the robust growth momentum of Taiwan’s technology manufacturing sector.
A detailed sector analysis shows that the information and electronics industry was the absolute driver behind this month’s record‑high index, posting a year‑over‑year growth of 27.42%.

Electronic components: In September, the sector grew 23.62% YoY, mainly due to strong demand from high‑performance computing and AI applications, coupled with inventory buildup for new consumer electronics, which boosted production of 12‑inch wafer foundry, IC packaging and testing, memory, IC design and substrates, resulting in a 21.07% increase for the first nine months compared with last year.

Computer electronic products and optical products: The booming development of AI applications and cloud services has prompted global cloud providers to accelerate the deployment of AI infrastructure, further strengthening semiconductor equipment investment. This drove substantial production growth in servers, semiconductor testing equipment and components, switches, solid‑state drives and other products, with a 45.92% YoY increase and an 80.05% rise for the first nine months.
In traditional industries, the continued expansion of semiconductor manufacturers and spill‑over demand from the AI supply chain have led several sectors to show production gains as well.

Machinery and equipment: The sector grew 26.02% YoY, driven by semiconductor firms expanding advanced processes and high‑end packaging capacity, which increased demand for equipment and components used in electronics and semiconductor production, as well as mechanical transmission equipment, alongside continued growth in machine‑tool orders.

Basic metal and automotive parts: Basic metal rose 1.39% YoY, reflecting a gradual recovery in market demand and higher output of hot‑rolled steel coils, plates and target materials. The automotive and parts sector, buoyed by warming demand and supportive electric‑vehicle policies, grew 2.35% YoY.

Chemical materials and fertilizer: This sector declined 4.29% YoY as demand for some products remained weak, although polished silicon wafers benefited from ongoing semiconductor demand and saw production increases.

Looking forward, the Ministry of Economic Affairs notes that while global economic growth is still subject to geopolitical and trade‑policy uncertainties, the expanding demand for emerging technologies such as AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, together with aggressive AI infrastructure investments by major cloud providers, will help sustain production momentum in Taiwan’s advanced semiconductor processes, high‑end packaging and server supply chains. Coupled with the upcoming year‑end consumer‑spending season, these factors are expected to support steady growth in the nation’s manufacturing output. The ministry estimates the October manufacturing production index will range from 141.56 to 145.86, reflecting a 20.5% to 24.2% annual increase.

items.title: 台積電運動會因颱風喊卡 「小禮物」特別獎金正常發放加碼到3萬元
items.title_en: TSMC Sports Day Cancelled by Typhoon, ‘Small Gift’ Special Bonus Still Paid and Boosted to NT$30,000
paras: 台積電(2330-TW)原定於10月24日運動會因為颱風薔琵取消，不過，「小禮物」特別獎金據悉仍將照常發出，且加碼達3萬元，高於去年的2.5萬元。
台積電近年運動會都發放特別獎金，且逐年加碼，從2023年1.6萬元、到2024年2萬元、2025年2.5萬元，到今年3萬元，只要符合資格的員工均可領到。
受到薔琵颱風影響，新竹縣市政府公告10月23日停止上班，台積電表示，由於運動會的準備工作也受到影響，考量人員安全，因此運動會將取消辦理。
paras_en: TSMC (2330‑TW) had scheduled its annual sports day for October 24, but the event was called off because of Typhoon Chanh‑pi. However, the “small‑gift” special bonus is reportedly still being issued as usual, and the amount has been increased to NT$30,000, up from NT$25,000 last year.

In recent years TSMC has awarded a special bonus at its sports day and has been raising the amount each year—NT$16,000 in 2023, NT$20,000 in 2024, NT$25,000 in 2025, and this year NT$30,000. Any employee who meets the eligibility criteria will receive the bonus.

Due to the impact of Typhoon Chanh‑pi, the Hsinchu County and City governments announced a work‑stop on October 23. TSMC said that because the preparation for the sports day was also affected and to ensure staff safety, the event will be cancelled.

items.title: 聯茂8、9月合賺22.1億元EPS 6.08元超越H1 前3季提前賺逾一股本
items.title_en: Lianmao Posts NT$2.21 B Combined Profit for August‑September, EPS NT$6.08 Beats H1; First Three Quarters Earn Over One Year’s Capital in Advance
paras: CCL廠聯茂電子(6213-TW)今(23)日公布最新獲利資訊，2026年9月營收達58.24億元，創歷史新高，單月稅後純益達12.86億元，每股純益(EPS)3.54元。加計8月稅後純益9.24億元，聯茂第三季光兩個月累計稅後純益就達22.1億元，每股純益合計6.08元，不僅獲利表現強勁，更已超越上半年稅後純益15.94億元。
聯茂2026年上半年營收為206.73億元，毛利率17.33%，稅後純益15.94億元，每股純益4.39元。若加計第三季8、9月獲利，前三季累計稅後純益已達38.04億元，每股純益合計10.47元，提前賺逾一個股本，獲利動能持續升溫。
在高階產品需求強勁帶動下，聯茂積極擴充泰國、江西、無錫及台灣等生產基地產能，預計2026年全球總產能將達每月570萬張。其中，泰國大型生產基地持續推進三期投資計畫，第一期預計於今年底完成，屆時產能將由每月30萬張倍增至60萬張，進一步提升高階材料供應能力。
聯茂泰國第二期擴產計畫也已打樁動工，初期規劃新增每月30萬張產能，公司規劃最快於2026年投產。隨著各地擴產計畫陸續推進，聯茂預估2029年全球總產能將進一步擴大至每月915萬張，持續因應AI及高階電子材料市場需求。
同時，聯茂持續提升泰國廠的技術層次，以因應在地PCB廠的擴廠生產需求，預計聯茂泰國廠於2026年完成M8 CCL的技術轉移，並於2027年完成M9產品技術轉移至泰國。而聯茂本身在M10產品的開發也在認證之中。
聯茂董事長陳進財先前指出，聯茂自2026年至2030年的全球生產規劃皆已完備，目前正依進度進行投資，但2026年尚無在公開市場籌資的規劃。
聯茂9月營收達58.2億元，月增15.5%、年增110.7%；第三季營收達156億元，優於市場預期並再創單季歷史新高。累計前9月營收達329.05億元，已超越歷年全年營收。法人分析，主要受惠於產品漲價效益持續反映，以及伺服器市場需求維持強勁。
paras_en: CCL manufacturer Lianmao Electronics (6213‑TW) today (23) announced the latest profit information, September 2026 revenue reached NT$5.824 billion, a historic high, monthly after‑tax net profit was NT$1.286 billion, EPS NT$3.54. Adding August after‑tax profit of NT$924 million, Lianmao’s Q3 two‑month cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$2.21 billion, EPS total NT$6.08, not only a strong performance but already exceeds the H1 after‑tax profit of NT$1.594 billion.

Lianmao’s H1 2026 revenue was NT$20.673 billion, gross margin 17.33%, after‑tax profit NT$1.594 billion, EPS NT$4.39. Including Q3 August‑September profit, the first three quarters cumulative after‑tax profit reached NT$3.804 billion, EPS NT$10.47, earning more than one year’s equity in advance, and profit momentum continues to heat up.

Driven by strong demand for high‑end products, Lianmao is actively expanding capacity at its plants in Thailand, Jiangxi, Wuxi and Taiwan, expecting total global capacity in 2026 to reach 5.7 million sheets per month. The large Thailand plant continues its Phase‑3 investment, with Phase‑1 expected to be completed by year‑end, raising capacity from 300,000 to 600,000 sheets per month, further boosting high‑end material supply capability.

The second‑phase expansion at the Thailand plant has also begun pile‑driving, initially adding 300,000 sheets per month, with the company planning to start production as early as 2026. As expansion projects progress, Lianmao forecasts global capacity to grow to 9.15 million sheets per month by 2029, continuing to meet AI and high‑end electronic material market demand.

At the same time, Lianmao is upgrading the technology level of its Thailand factory to meet local PCB fab expansion needs, expecting to complete M8 CCL technology transfer at the Thailand plant in 2026 and finish M9 product technology transfer there in 2027. Lianmao’s own M10 product development is also under certification.

Chairman Chen Jin‑cai previously noted that Lianmao’s global production plan for 2026‑2030 is fully set, and investments are proceeding on schedule, but there is no plan to raise capital in the public market in 2026.

Lianmao’s September revenue hit NT$5.82 billion, up 15.5% month‑over‑month and 110.7% year‑over‑year; Q3 revenue reached NT$15.6 billion, beating market expectations and setting a new quarterly record. Cumulative revenue for the first nine months reached NT$32.905 billion, surpassing any full‑year revenue in history. Analysts say the results are mainly due to continued price‑increase benefits and strong server market demand.

items.title: 玉晶光獲3M參與私募股款已到位持股4.68% 自結9月EPS達3.85元
items.title_en: Yujing Optical Secures 3M Participation in Private Placement, Stake Reaches 4.68%, September EPS Hits T$3.85
paras: 獲美商3M以逾48億元參與私募現增案並取得約 4.68% 股權的光學鏡頭與精密光學元件大廠玉晶光(3406-TW)，今(23)日公布最新自結獲利資訊，玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，自結單月稅後純益4.34億元，年減15%，單月每股純益3.85元。
玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。
展望第四季營運，玉晶光指出，端視客戶新機銷售狀況，另其它領域的產品目前仍在積極送樣、認證，目前進度符合公司預期。
3M 預計參與玉晶光的私募發行新股，認購玉晶光普通股5534張，每股認購價格為869.6元，投資總金額高達48.13億元（約1.5億美金元），股款並已匯入，3M透過參與私募將取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光長期積累的精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
玉晶光在2026年上半年營收118.23億元，毛利率33.37%，稅後純益15.77億元，每股純益13.99元。
paras_en: Yujing Optical (3406‑TW), a leading manufacturer of optical lenses and precision optical components that received participation from U.S. company 3M in a private placement raising over T$4.8 billion and acquiring about a 4.68% stake, announced its latest self‑reported profit figures today (23rd). For September 2026, Yujing posted revenue of T$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year, with a net profit after tax of T$434 million, a 15% year‑over‑year decline, and earnings per share of T$3.85 for the month.

The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, saw Yujing’s quarterly revenue reach T$7.816 billion, entering a historically high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, Yujing’s revenue totaled T$19.631 billion, a 10.21% increase year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead to the fourth quarter, Yujing said its performance will depend on customers’ new product sales, while products in other segments are still being actively sampled and certified, with progress currently meeting the company’s expectations.

3M plans to participate in Yujing’s private placement of new shares, subscribing to 5,534 ordinary shares at a price of T$869.6 per share, for a total investment of T$4.813 billion (approximately US$150 million). The funds have already been transferred, and through this private placement 3M will obtain roughly a 4.68% equity stake in Yujing.

The extensive collaboration between Yujing and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing’s long‑standing precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑precision assembly technology. Yujing’s production team will fully support the mass‑production preparation of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.
In the first half of 2026, Yujing reported revenue of T$11.823 billion, a gross margin of 33.37%, net profit after tax of T$1.577 billion, and earnings per share of T$13.99.

items.title: 揚明光連三季獲利 前三季EPS 0.11元
items.title_en: Yang Ming Optical Posts Profit for Three Consecutive Quarters, EPS 0.11 NT$ for First Three Quarters
paras: 光學元件廠揚明光學(3504-TW)今(23)日召開董事會，公告第三季稅後純益122萬元，季減76.25%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益0.01元；前三季稅後純益1234萬元，每股純益0.11元，較去年同期由虧轉盈。
展望第四季，揚明光學指出，光學元件類產品受物流投影鏡頭客戶啟動新版本變更計畫影響，相關需求可能遞延或暫緩，預估出貨動能將下修；3D列印產品隨新機種逐步導入客戶端測試，出貨預期略增；其餘產品線因接近年底，客戶備貨轉趨保守，預計出貨較第三季持平或略減。整體而言，預估第四季出貨量將較第三季減少。
揚明光學2026年第三季營收7.46億元，毛利率16.8%，季增0.36個百分點、年減0.22個百分點，營業損失872萬元；前三季營收21.7億元，毛利率17.13%，年增0.94個百分點。
揚明光學表示，第三季智能家居新機種持續放量，但低階舊型鏡頭也進入終止階段，取像光學產品出貨表現持平；光學元件類產品因客戶AR眼鏡進入量產，出貨較上季增加；3D列印產品則因進入新舊機種銜接期，受到客戶端調整舊機種庫存及新機驗證雙重影響，本季出貨相對放緩。
車用產品方面，揚明光學第三季隨LiDAR鏡頭新機種順利量產，逐步取代舊機種，帶動出貨量略增。
paras_en: Optical component manufacturer Yang Ming Optical (3504‑TW) held its board meeting today (23rd) and announced a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.22 million, down 76.25% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year, resulting in earnings per share of NT$0.01; for the first three quarters the after‑tax net profit was NT$12.34 million, EPS NT$0.11, also turning a loss into a profit versus the prior year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Yang Ming Optical noted that demand for optical‑component products may be delayed or postponed due to logistics projection‑lens customers launching new version change programs, so shipment momentum is expected to be revised downward; 3D‑printing products are gradually being introduced to customer testing with new models, so shipments are expected to rise slightly; other product lines, as the year‑end approaches, see customers becoming more conservative in inventory, so shipments are expected to be flat or slightly lower than Q3. Overall, Q4 shipment volume is projected to be lower than Q3.

Yang Ming Optical reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$746 million, gross margin 16.8%, up 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 0.22 points year‑over‑year, and an operating loss of NT$8.72 million; for the first three quarters revenue was NT$2.17 billion, gross margin 17.13%, up 0.94 percentage points year‑over‑year.

The company said that in Q3 the new smart‑home models continued to ramp up, while low‑end legacy lenses entered the phase‑out stage, keeping imaging‑optics product shipments flat; optical‑component products saw higher shipments as a customer’s AR glasses entered mass production; 3D‑printing products experienced a slowdown this quarter because they are in a transition period between old and new models, affected by customers adjusting old‑model inventory and validating new models.
In the automotive segment, Yang Ming Optical’s new LiDAR lens models were successfully mass‑produced in Q3, gradually replacing older models and driving a modest increase in shipment volume.

items.title: AI股也能當防禦股？分析師：輝達可望成資金避風港
items.title_en: Can AI Stocks Also Be Defensive? Analyst: Nvidia Could Become a Safe Haven for Capital
paras: 隨著華爾街重新檢視人工智慧 (AI) 熱潮背後的龐大支出與債務風險，投資人的目光開始從高成長題材轉向獲利能見度。部分分析師認為，輝達 (NVDA-US) 憑藉市場主導地位、產品升級與相對偏低的估值，可望成為希望保留 AI 曝險、同時降低風險的資金避風港。
《MarketWatch》週五 (23 日) 報導，輝達今年來股價累計上漲約 14%，僅略優於標普 500 指數，相較其他 AI 熱門股，表現相對溫和。今年稍早，投資人積極尋找晶片、電力等領域的新投資機會，如今則更加關注支撐 AI 擴張的融資結構，以及業者能否實現未來數年的高成長預期。
Laffer Tengler Investments 資深分析師 Jamie Meyers 表示，輝達目前的交易估值宛如價值股，成長潛力卻相當驚人。
他預期，隨著產品從 Blackwell 平台轉向下一代 Rubin 平台，將帶動銷售大幅成長，而強勁的 AI 需求也將持續支撐基本面。
Meyers 認為，在市場可能進一步震盪的情況下，輝達可視為科技股中較具防禦性的選擇。
Direxion 資本市場主管 Jake Behan 則指出，對希望持續參與 AI 題材、但採取相對穩健策略的投資人而言，輝達具有吸引力，因為它提供的是各種競爭策略背後所需的基礎設施。無論頂尖 AI 實驗室與大型雲端服務商如何爭奪模型領先地位，其龐大支出最終都有利於輝達。
不過，這種防禦性是相對於其他 AI 投資而言，並不代表輝達具備美債等傳統避險資產的安全性。
Gabelli Funds 基金經理人 Hendi Susanto 也表示，輝達在晶片市場的主導地位、未來需求能見度，以及長期獲利潛力，使目前估值對投資人具有吸引力。
根據道瓊市場數據，輝達目前股價約為未來 12 個月預估每股盈餘的 15 倍，在費城半導體指數成分股中，本益比為第 3 低。
然而，Seaport Research 分析師 Jay Goldberg 仍維持「賣出」評等。根據 FactSet 統計，他是該平台追蹤的分析師中，唯一給予輝達賣出評等者。儘管他也提出輝達是否可能成為不確定市場中的避風港，仍認為產業競爭與客戶融資風險值得警惕。
Goldberg 的主要疑慮之一，是購買輝達 GPU 並出租算力的新興 AI 雲端業者 (neocloud)。他指出，這類公司的估值高度取決於長期資本支出假設，但若要創造企業價值，龐大的支出終究必須逐步收斂。
輝達與 CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 等業者關係密切，而這些公司為擴充算力已承擔大量債務。
Goldberg 認為，輝達持續推出新品、提高價格並提供具吸引力的融資安排，可能進一步加重客戶負債。若這些業者未能順利發展，衝擊將回頭反映在輝達銷售與利潤率上。
他也擔心，人力與電力短缺可能拖慢 AI 基礎建設進度。依其估計，明年規劃的算力建設規模達 55 吉瓦 (GW)，但實際可落地規模可能僅有 20 至 25 吉瓦。
此外，Goldberg 指出，輝達上一季做出的各項承諾約達 2,500 億美元。儘管公司有能力承擔龐大支出，若相關投入持續擴張，仍可能加重資產負債表負擔。
Goldberg 認為，隨著算力市場最終走向飽和，目前獲得輝達支持的雲端業者，可能在需求放緩時更加依賴輝達提供財務支援，進而壓縮其現金流。這並非短期內的風險，但仍值得留意。
展望未來 6 個月，Goldberg 承認，其他晶片業者若遭遇供應限制，可能有利於輝達股價表現；但他仍將輝達與新興雲端業者的融資交易，視為公司面臨競爭壓力升高的訊號。
paras_en: As Wall Street re‑examines the massive spending and debt risks behind the AI hype, investors are shifting their focus from high‑growth themes to profit visibility. Some analysts believe Nvidia (NVDA‑US), thanks to its market dominance, product upgrades and relatively modest valuation, could become a safe haven for funds that want exposure to AI while lowering risk.

MarketWatch reported on Friday (the 23rd) that Nvidia’s stock has risen about 14% so far this year, only slightly outpacing the S&P 500 and delivering a more muted performance than other hot AI stocks. Earlier this year investors were hunting for new opportunities in chips, power and other sectors; now they are paying closer attention to the financing structures that support AI expansion and whether companies can meet the high growth expectations for the coming years.
Senior analyst Jamie Meyers of Laffer Tengler Investments said Nvidia’s current trading valuation looks like a value stock, yet its growth potential is remarkable.
He expects that as the product line shifts from the Blackwell platform to the next‑generation Rubin platform, sales will surge, and strong AI demand will continue to underpin the fundamentals.
Meyers believes that in a market that could see further volatility, Nvidia can be viewed as a relatively defensive choice among tech stocks.

Direxion’s head of capital markets Jake Behan noted that for investors who want to stay in AI themes but adopt a more prudent strategy, Nvidia is attractive because it provides the essential infrastructure behind a variety of competitive approaches. Whether top AI labs or large cloud providers vie for model leadership, their massive spending ultimately benefits Nvidia.
However, this defensiveness is relative to other AI investments and does not give Nvidia the safety of traditional safe‑haven assets such as U.S. Treasuries.
Gabelli Funds manager Hendi Susanto also said Nvidia’s dominant position in the chip market, visible future demand and long‑term profit potential make its current valuation appealing to investors.

According to Dow Jones market data, Nvidia’s share price is about 15 times its estimated earnings per share for the next 12 months, ranking as the third‑lowest P/E among the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index constituents.

Nevertheless, Seaport Research analyst Jay Goldberg still maintains a “sell” rating. Based on FactSet data, he is the only analyst covering the stock on the platform to give a sell recommendation. While he acknowledges the question of whether Nvidia could become a safe haven in an uncertain market, he believes industry competition and customer financing risks warrant caution.

One of Goldberg’s main concerns is the emerging AI cloud providers (neoclouds) that buy Nvidia GPUs and lease compute capacity. He points out that these companies’ valuations depend heavily on long‑term cap‑ex assumptions, but the huge spending must eventually converge to create corporate value.
Nvidia has close ties with firms such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), which have taken on substantial debt to expand compute capacity.

Goldberg argues that Nvidia’s continual rollout of new products, price hikes and attractive financing terms could further increase customer indebtedness. If these customers struggle to develop, the impact will feed back into Nvidia’s sales and profit margins.

He also worries that shortages of labor and electricity could slow AI infrastructure build‑out. He estimates that next year’s planned compute capacity totals 55 GW, but the amount that can actually be deployed may be only 20‑25 GW.

Moreover, Goldberg notes that Nvidia pledged roughly $250 billion in commitments last quarter. Although the company can shoulder large expenditures, continued expansion of such investments could still weigh on its balance sheet.

Goldberg believes that as the compute market eventually saturates, cloud providers that rely on Nvidia may become more dependent on Nvidia’s financial support when demand eases, compressing their cash flow. This is not a short‑term risk but remains worth monitoring.

Looking ahead to the next six months, Goldberg concedes that supply constraints affecting other chip makers could benefit Nvidia’s stock performance; however, he still views Nvidia’s financing deals with emerging cloud providers as a signal of rising competitive pressure on the company.
