AI基建風暴升溫！新雲端業者全線重挫、信用風險攀升、Solidigm撤回IPO

AI基礎建設投資本週經歷動盪的一週。《CNBC》報導，新型雲端業者（Neocloud）股價重挫，信用違約交換（CDS）利差飆升，Meta(META-US)自由現金流轉為負值，南韓SK海力士(SK Hynix)旗下Solidigm也取消IPO計畫。全文詳讀

AI股遭拋售重創資料中心設備商 財報亮眼仍難逃賣壓

AI資料中心建設熱潮中的兩大關鍵供應商，剛公布遠優於預期的財報，華爾街卻依然大舉拋售這些公司的股票。Bloom Energy(BE-US)四表示，上季營收年增138%，並將全年營收成長展望上修至約122%。負責安裝資料中心冷卻與電力系統的 Comfort Systems(FIX-US)則表示，未完成訂單金額幾乎翻倍，達到178億美元。然而兩檔股票週五(23日)連續第二個交易日大幅下跌。全文詳讀

三星德州廠加碼2奈米設備！2027年下半年月產能可望達2萬片

三星電子持續擴大美國先進製程布局，據《ZDNet Korea》週五 (23 日) 引述業界消息報導，三星已為德州泰勒第一廠追加設備訂單，可支應每月約 6,000 片的 2 奈米晶圓產能。連同先前設備投資及早期試產線，該廠預計於 2027 年下半年具備每月 2 萬片產能，達到設計上限。全文詳讀

美銀：股市避險情緒料延續至11月中旬

美國銀行(BofA)投資策略師Michael Hartnett在最新報告中指出，市場投資人的避險情緒預計將一路延續至11月中旬。在市場真正探尋到支撐底部之前，股市、美債殖利率及美元指數恐將進一步走低，其團隊目前在戰術配置上維持避險立場。全文詳讀

能否再超車？蘋果市值距輝達僅差420億美元 iPhone Duo與Q4財報成關鍵

蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 正加速追趕輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US)，爭奪全球市值最高上市公司的寶座。隨著蘋果首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 於10月23日正式開賣，加上公司即將於11月2日公布2026會計年度第四季財報，市場正密切關注新機銷售表現、假期購物旺季展望及獲利能力，這幾項因素將左右蘋果股價能否進一步超越輝達。全文詳讀
paras_en: AI infrastructure storm intensifies! New cloud providers plunge across the board, credit risk rises, Solidigm withdraws IPO

AI stocks face heavy sell‑offs despite strong earnings from data‑center equipment makers. Bloom Energy (BE-US) reported Q4 revenue up 138% YoY and lifted its full‑year revenue growth outlook to about 122%. Comfort Systems (FIX-US), which installs data‑center cooling and power systems, said its backlog nearly doubled to $17.8 billion. Yet both stocks fell sharply on Friday the 23rd for the second consecutive trading day.

Samsung adds 2‑nm equipment to its Texas fab! With the new order, the Taylor, Texas plant can support roughly 6,000 2‑nm wafers per month. Combined with earlier equipment investments and early‑stage pilot lines, the facility is expected to reach a design‑capacity of 20,000 wafers per month by the second half of 2027.

Bank of America: Stock‑market risk‑off sentiment likely to persist into mid‑November. BofA investment strategist Michael Hartnett said in a latest note that investors’ defensive posture is expected to continue through mid‑November. Until the market finds a firm bottom, equities, U.S. Treasury yields and the dollar index could slide further, and the team is maintaining a tactical defensive stance.

Can Apple overtake Nvidia? Apple (AAPL-US) is closing the gap with Nvidia (NVDA-US), trailing by just $42 billion in market value. With the launch of its first foldable iPhone Duo on October 23 and the upcoming FY2026 Q4 earnings release on November 2, the market is watching sales of the new device, holiday‑season demand and profitability closely, as these factors will determine whether Apple can surpass Nvidia’s valuation.

items.title: 馬斯克終極野心：打造科技「全棧帝國」從衛星、電力到晶片與機器人 拿下AI產業命脈
items.title_en: Musk's Ultimate Ambition: Building a Full‑Stack Tech Empire from Satellites, Power, Chips to Robots, Seizing the AI Industry's Lifeblood
paras: 馬斯克正加速打造橫跨衛星通訊、太空運輸、人工智慧 (AI) 算力、能源、晶片及機器人的垂直整合科技帝國。隨著SpaceX第三季營收大幅成長、AI運算基礎設施快速擴張，以及特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US) 與SpaceX可能合併的討論浮上檯面，馬斯克的終極布局逐漸清晰：從衛星傳輸、電力供應、晶片與AI模型，到機器人及終端設備，盡可能將AI產業鏈的關鍵環節掌握在同一個企業體系內。
SpaceX第三季營收達146億美元，年增161%，比華爾街預期高出逾20億美元，並首次實現正的營業利益。財務長Bret Johnsen預估，2027年第一季營收可望達330億至370億美元，且年度化經常性營收將在今年12月前突破1,000億美元。馬斯克也證實，SpaceX與特斯拉的獨立董事特別委員會正在討論兩家公司合併的可能性。
若合併成真，SpaceX將結合火箭發射、全球衛星通訊、AI運算與能源供應，以及特斯拉的汽車製造、自動駕駛、能源儲存和Optimus人形機器人業務，形成涵蓋太空、地面及數位世界的科技平台。這不僅是企業規模的擴張，更是馬斯克試圖控制AI產業核心基礎設施的長期戰略。
SpaceX旗下Starlink衛星網路已成為這套布局的重要起點。第三季Starlink新增160萬名用戶，總訂戶數達1,360萬人。相較之下，美國電信商威瑞森 (Verizon) (VZ-US) 擁有約1.47億個無線連線，AT&T (T-US) 約有1.1億個無線連線，但Starlink的成長速度相當突出。
Starlink訂戶數從2023年底的230萬人，增加至2024年底的440萬人，2025年底進一步升至890萬人，2026年前三季又新增470萬人。單看第三季，AT&T僅新增37.9萬名後付費用戶，威瑞森則新增18.4萬名，顯示衛星通訊服務正以不同於傳統電信業者的方式擴張。
Starlink在航空市場的滲透也持續增加，目前約有1.2萬架商用飛機採用其服務。航空公司之間的網路服務差異，可能因此成為競爭變數之一。報導指出，美國聯合航空已採用Starlink服務，達美航空則尚未導入。
除了衛星寬頻，SpaceX也正透過Starlink Mobile切入行動通訊市場。這項服務無須架設屋頂天線，而是透過T-Mobile (TMUS-US) 等合作電信商，讓一般手機直接連接衛星。Starlink Mobile每月活躍用戶已達2,200萬人，第三季成長37%。
SpaceX近期另與EchoStar (SATS-US) 達成協議，計畫以約170億美元收購無線頻譜，並預計於2028年初推出完整的行動電信服務。若計畫順利推進，SpaceX將不再只是向電信業者提供衛星連線能力，也有機會直接進入行動通訊服務市場。
在衛星技術方面，SpaceX新一代V3衛星的單顆下載容量可達每秒1太比特 (Tbps)，理論上可同時支援約20萬條影片串流。每枚Starship星艦火箭可搭載60顆這類衛星。2026年9月進行的第14次星艦飛行，單次部署所對應的頻寬達每秒26太比特，超過衛訊公司 (Viasat) (VSAT-US) 整個ViaSat-3衛星星系容量的8倍。
研究機構TeleGeography估計，截至2026年年中，全球國際網路總容量約為每秒2,259太比特，主要仰賴海底電纜。SpaceX計畫在2027年將星艦發射頻率提高至每週一次，長期目標則是每天發射。若發射頻率、衛星部署與網路容量持續提升，Starlink的全球傳輸規模將進一步擴大，並可能對傳統海底電纜與地面網路形成新的競爭壓力。
然而，馬斯克的野心並不止於傳輸網路。他也正積極擴大SpaceX的AI運算能力，試圖成為全球最重要的算力供應商之一。報導指出，SpaceX目前每月約有22萬顆輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) GB300晶片投入運作，馬斯克表示，明年還將加快部署速度。
根據鴻海相關披露，SpaceX已向鴻海下訂約93.6萬顆GB300晶片，訂單價值約520億美元，交付期限延伸至2027年第一季。業界估計，輝達今年Blackwell系列晶片總產量約550萬至600萬顆，SpaceX的採購量約占其中40%，使其成為輝達目前最大的單一客戶。
SpaceX已在美國田納西州孟菲斯建成Colossus 2資料中心，報導將其描述為全球最大的AI資料中心，但這仍只是整體擴張計畫的一部分。SpaceX的算力截至2026年9月底已達1.7吉瓦 (GW)，預計10月底接近2吉瓦，12月底進一步升至2.5至3吉瓦。
到了2027年第二季，SpaceX計畫啟動一座配備44萬顆輝達下一代Vera Rubin晶片的訓練叢集，並將每年新增10吉瓦算力列為目標。馬斯克對此表示高度信心，甚至認為實際新增規模不太可能低於13吉瓦。
外部企業對SpaceX算力的需求同樣可觀。AI公司Anthropic已承諾在2029年前向SpaceX租用價值約845億美元的算力；Alphabet旗下Google則同意自2026年10月至2029年6月，每月向SpaceX支付9.2億美元購買算力。
值得注意的是，Google本身具備自研晶片與大型運算叢集，但仍選擇向SpaceX採購算力，反映AI產業目前面臨的瓶頸不只是晶片供應，更包括資料中心所需的電力與基礎設施。當大型AI模型訓練和推論需求快速成長，能夠同時掌握晶片、電力及資料中心的企業，將有機會取得更大的議價能力。
電力供應因此成為馬斯克布局中不可或缺的一環。美國通用電氣維諾瓦 (GE Vernova) (GEV-US) 是美國資料中心燃氣渦輪機的重要供應商之一，但其訂單已排滿至2030年。報導指出，該公司待交付訂單達116吉瓦，年度產能卻僅約20吉瓦，顯示資料中心電力設備供應存在明顯限制。
為降低對外部供應商的依賴，SpaceX選擇自行建設發電系統。公司已在密西西比州Southaven建成自有發電設施，配置41部燃氣渦輪機，裝置容量達1.2吉瓦；另向韓國斗山重工採購5部容量各為380兆瓦的設備。
馬斯克表示，SpaceX的能源技術具有高度專有性，其優勢來自火箭引擎製造所累積的先進鑄造能力，可自行製造燃氣渦輪機葉片，將電力設施部署時間縮短12至18個月。
SpaceX計畫在2027年建置20吉瓦的發電與冷卻設施，以確保算力擴張不受電力限制。報導估計，若公司在2027年底前實現20吉瓦燃氣渦輪機裝置容量，每日天然氣消耗量可能達30億至45億立方英尺，相當於美國能源資訊署預估2027年全年美國天然氣產量增量中的大部分。
不過，快速擴張也帶來龐大的資金壓力。SpaceX第三季營業活動現金流約96億美元，資本支出卻高達196億美元，因此自由現金流約為負100億美元。財務長Johnsen更預估，第四季資本支出將達350億至400億美元，約為投資人先前預期的兩倍。
與大型雲端服務商相比，SpaceX的資本支出強度尤其突出。報導估計，亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 今年每取得1美元營收，約投入0.27美元於資本支出，微軟 (Microsoft) (MSFT-US) 與Alphabet也處於相近水準；SpaceX的資本支出與營收比率則約為2.50倍，相當於亞馬遜的9倍左右。
截至2026年9月底，SpaceX持有899億美元現金及短期投資，負債為388億美元。第三季EBITDA約88億美元，年化約350億美元。目前負債約為年化EBITDA的1倍，低於標普全球 (S&P Global) 對投資等級企業通常維持的2倍上限。
儘管現有資產負債結構仍保有一定空間，若SpaceX要完成10吉瓦算力建設並維持投資等級信用評等，仍可能需要額外融資。潛在方式包括增發股票、由輝達等供應商提供晶片融資，或向客戶收取預付款。
報導引述的標普全球預測指出，SpaceX借款規模可能在2028年達到1,320億美元，自由現金流則可能直到2030年才轉正。換言之，馬斯克正在以龐大資本投入，提前搶占未來AI算力市場，但投資回收速度仍將取決於企業需求、算力租賃價格與基礎設施建設進度。
特斯拉與SpaceX合併的構想，則可能成為這套垂直整合體系的最後一塊拼圖。馬斯克已確認，兩家公司獨立董事組成的特別委員會正在討論合併方案，但目前仍屬評估階段，尚未代表交易已經敲定。
若合併完成，SpaceX將取得特斯拉的工廠、自動駕駛技術及Optimus人形機器人業務，並有機會將AI算力直接應用於車輛運作與工廠生產。Starlink衛星可提供自動駕駛車輛、機器人及其他自主系統所需的通訊連線，特斯拉的電池與能源儲存技術則可能支援SpaceX日益增加的資料中心用電需求。
雙方已推進的合作計畫Terafab，正是整合晶片與AI運算的重要項目，目標是生產特斯拉自動駕駛車輛、Optimus機器人，以及SpaceX AI與資料中心所需的先進晶片，馬斯克希望在2028年底前啟動量產。
特斯拉的大規模工廠自動化經驗，也可能協助SpaceX提高星艦的工業化生產效率；SpaceX的火箭技術則可能進一步應用於特斯拉未來產品。兩家公司合併後，也有機會整合電池、半導體、製造設備、推進系統、衛星硬體與特殊金屬等供應鏈。
從產業結構來看，馬斯克的策略是將AI所需的晶片、電力、傳輸、運算模型與實體終端設備盡可能納入同一體系。當AI運算成本愈來愈取決於晶片、電力與資料傳輸效率，能夠控制多個環節的企業，便可能在各個層級取得利潤，並降低對外部供應商的依賴。
不過，合併也伴隨治理、監管及執行風險。SpaceX是美國軍方、情報機構及NASA的重要承包商，特斯拉則與中國市場及上海工廠有深度連結。兩家公司若合併，可能面臨更嚴格的美國國安審查、中國監管關注，以及股東對利益衝突、投票權與資本配置的疑慮。
此外，星艦、無人計程車、人形機器人、AI資料中心、行動通訊及軌道運算設施，都是成本高昂且技術挑戰極大的計畫。將這些業務整合在同一家公司，並不會消除技術風險，只是讓它們集中於同一個企業架構之下。
從營收規模來看，報導預估SpaceX在2027年底前，單季營收有機會超過500億美元，接近2025年第三季56億美元的9倍。這項預測能否實現，仍取決於AI算力需求是否持續成長，以及SpaceX能否將晶片、電力、衛星與資料中心建設轉化為穩定的商業收入。
馬斯克打造科技帝國的核心，不再只是製造更便宜的電動車或發射更多火箭，而是將AI時代最關鍵的基礎設施整合起來。從Starlink的全球通訊、SpaceX的算力與自建能源，到特斯拉的汽車、工廠及機器人，這套布局試圖建立一個從太空延伸至地面的完整技術生態系。但在營收高速成長的另一面，龐大資本支出、融資需求與多項高風險技術計畫，也將成為這場長期投資能否成功的關鍵考驗。
paras_en: Musk is accelerating the creation of a vertically integrated tech empire that spans satellite communications, space transport, artificial‑intelligence (AI) compute, energy, chips and robots. With SpaceX’s Q3 revenue soaring, AI compute infrastructure expanding rapidly, and talks of a possible Tesla (TSLA‑US)‑SpaceX merger surfacing, Musk’s ultimate layout is becoming clearer: from satellite transmission, power supply, chips and AI models to robots and end‑devices, he aims to keep the key links of the AI value chain within a single corporate system.

SpaceX reported Q3 revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year‑over‑year, more than $2 billion above Wall Street expectations, and posted its first positive operating profit. CFO Bret Johnsen projects Q1 2027 revenue of $33‑$37 billion, with annualized recurring revenue expected to exceed $100 billion by December 2024. Musk also confirmed that a special committee of independent directors at Tesla is discussing a possible merger with SpaceX.

If a merger materializes, SpaceX would combine rocket launches, global satellite communications, AI compute and power supply with Tesla’s car manufacturing, autonomous driving, energy storage and Optimus humanoid‑robot businesses, forming a tech platform that spans space, ground and digital realms. This is not merely a scale expansion but a long‑term strategy for Musk to control the core infrastructure of the AI industry.

SpaceX’s Starlink satellite network is a cornerstone of this plan. In Q3, Starlink added 1.6 million new users, bringing total subscriptions to 13.6 million. By comparison, U.S. telecoms Verizon (VZ‑US) and AT&T (T‑US) have roughly 147 million and 110 million wireless connections respectively, but Starlink’s growth rate is strikingly high.

Starlink’s subscriber base grew from 2.3 million at the end of 2023 to 4.4 million at the end of 2024 and is projected to reach 8.9 million by the end of 2025, with an additional 4.7 million added in the first three quarters of 2026. In Q3 alone, AT&T added only 379,000 post‑paid customers while Verizon added 184,000, underscoring how satellite service is expanding in a manner distinct from traditional telcos.

Starlink’s penetration of the aviation market is also rising, now serving about 12,000 commercial aircraft. Differences in in‑flight connectivity could become a competitive factor; United Airlines has adopted Starlink, while Delta has not yet done so.

Beyond satellite broadband, SpaceX is entering the mobile market with Starlink Mobile, which requires no rooftop antenna and connects directly to satellites via partners such as T‑Mobile (TMUS‑US). Starlink Mobile now has 22 million monthly active users, up 37% in Q3.

SpaceX recently struck a deal with EchoStar (SATS‑US) to acquire roughly $17 billion of wireless spectrum, with plans to launch a full‑service mobile telecom operation in early 2028. If successful, SpaceX would move from merely providing satellite backhaul to becoming a direct mobile‑service provider.

Technologically, SpaceX’s next‑gen V3 satellites can download up to 1 terabit per second (Tbps) per unit, theoretically supporting about 200,000 simultaneous video streams. Each Starship launch can carry 60 of these satellites. The 14th Starship flight in September 2026 deployed bandwidth of 26 Tbps, eight times the total capacity of Viasat’s (VSAT‑US) ViaSat‑3 constellation.

Research firm TeleGeography estimates global international‑network capacity at about 2,259 Tbps as of mid‑2026, largely reliant on submarine cables. SpaceX aims to increase Starship launch cadence to once per week in 2027, with a long‑term goal of daily launches. Continued growth in launch rate, satellite deployment and network capacity would expand Starlink’s global transport scale and pressure traditional submarine‑cable and terrestrial networks.

Musk’s ambitions extend beyond connectivity. He is aggressively scaling SpaceX’s AI compute capability to become one of the world’s premier compute providers. Reports indicate SpaceX currently runs roughly 220,000 NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) GB300 chips each month, with plans to accelerate deployment next year.

According to disclosures from Foxconn, SpaceX has ordered 936,000 GB300 chips from the contract manufacturer, a deal worth about $52 billion, with deliveries stretched to Q1 2027. Industry estimates place NVIDIA’s annual Blackwell output at 5.5‑6 million chips, meaning SpaceX’s order represents roughly 40% of production, making it NVIDIA’s largest single customer today.

SpaceX has built the Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, Tennessee, touted as the world’s largest AI data center, though it is only part of a broader expansion plan. By the end of September 2026, SpaceX’s compute capacity reached 1.7 GW, expected to approach 2 GW by October and rise to 2.5‑3 GW by year‑end.

By Q2 2027, SpaceX plans to launch a training cluster equipped with 440,000 next‑generation NVIDIA Vera Rubin chips, targeting an annual addition of 10 GW of compute. Musk is confident the actual increase could exceed 13 GW.

External demand for SpaceX compute is also sizable. AI firm Anthropic has pledged to lease about $84.5 billion of compute from SpaceX through 2029, while Google, under Alphabet, agreed to pay $920 million per month for SpaceX compute from October 2026 through June 2029.

Google already develops its own chips and massive compute clusters, yet it still opts to buy compute from SpaceX, highlighting that AI bottlenecks now involve not only chip supply but also power and data‑center infrastructure. As large‑model training and inference demand accelerates, firms that control chips, electricity and facilities gain stronger bargaining power.

Power supply is therefore a critical piece of Musk’s puzzle. GE Vernova (GEV‑US), a major supplier of gas turbines for U.S. data centers, has its order book filled through 2030. The company has pending orders totaling 116 GW, yet its annual production capacity is only about 20 GW, indicating a clear supply constraint for data‑center power equipment.

To reduce reliance on external vendors, SpaceX is building its own power generation. It has installed a private plant in Southaven, Mississippi, with 41 gas turbines delivering 1.2 GW of capacity, and has ordered five 380‑MW units from South Korea’s Doosan Heavy Industries.

Musk says SpaceX’s energy technology is highly proprietary, leveraging advanced casting capabilities honed in rocket‑engine manufacturing to produce turbine blades in‑house, cutting deployment time for power assets by 12‑18 months.

SpaceX plans to build 20 GW of generation and cooling capacity by 2027 to ensure compute expansion is not power‑constrained. Analysts estimate that achieving 20 GW of gas‑turbine capacity by year‑end 2027 could require daily natural‑gas consumption of 3‑4.5 billion cubic feet, roughly the bulk of the incremental U.S. gas production projected by the EIA for 2027.

Rapid expansion, however, brings heavy capital pressure. SpaceX’s Q3 operating cash flow was about $9.6 billion, while capital expenditures topped $19.6 billion, yielding a free‑cash‑flow deficit of roughly $10 billion. CFO Johnsen forecasts Q4 capex of $35‑$40 billion, about twice what investors had anticipated.

Compared with major cloud providers, SpaceX’s capex intensity is extreme. Amazon (AMZN‑US) spends roughly $0.27 of capex for every $1 of revenue this year; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Alphabet are similar. SpaceX’s capex‑to‑revenue ratio is about 2.5×, roughly nine times Amazon’s level.

As of September 2026, SpaceX held $89.9 billion in cash and short‑term investments against $38.8 billion of debt. Q3 EBITDA was about $8.8 billion, annualized to roughly $35 billion. Debt now equals about one times annualized EBITDA, well below the 2× ceiling typical for investment‑grade issuers per S&P Global.

While the current balance sheet still offers headroom, completing a 10 GW compute build‑out and maintaining an investment‑grade rating may still require additional financing. Options include equity raises, chip‑financing from suppliers like NVIDIA, or taking advance payments from customers.

S&P Global forecasts SpaceX’s borrowings could reach $132 billion by 2028, with free cash flow not turning positive until 2030. In other words, Musk is pouring massive capital into the future AI‑compute market, but the pay‑back timeline will hinge on customer demand, compute‑rental pricing and infrastructure rollout speed.

The Tesla‑SpaceX merger concept could be the final piece of this vertical integration. Musk confirmed a special committee of independent directors from both companies is evaluating a merger, but it remains in the assessment stage and does not yet represent a finalized deal.

If merged, SpaceX would acquire Tesla’s factories, autonomous‑driving technology and Optimus robot business, and could apply AI compute directly to vehicle operation and factory production. Starlink could supply the communications link needed for autonomous cars, robots and other autonomous systems, while Tesla’s batteries and energy‑storage tech could meet SpaceX’s growing data‑center power needs.

The joint “Terafab” effort already underway is a key chip‑and‑AI‑compute integration project, aimed at producing advanced chips for Tesla’s self‑driving cars, Optimus robots and SpaceX’s AI and data‑center workloads, with mass production targeted for the end of 2028.

Tesla’s large‑scale factory automation expertise could help SpaceX improve Starship’s industrial production efficiency; conversely, SpaceX’s rocket technology could find applications in future Tesla products. Post‑merger, the combined entity could integrate supply chains for batteries, semiconductors, manufacturing equipment, propulsion systems, satellite hardware and specialty metals.

From an industry‑structure perspective, Musk’s strategy is to bring the chips, power, transmission, compute models and physical end‑devices required for AI into a single ecosystem. As AI compute costs become increasingly tied to chip efficiency, electricity and data‑transfer performance, firms that control multiple layers can capture profit at each level and reduce dependence on outside suppliers.

However, a merger also brings governance, regulatory and execution risks. SpaceX is a major contractor for the U.S. military, intelligence agencies and NASA, while Tesla has deep ties to the Chinese market and its Shanghai plant. A combined company could face stricter U.S. national‑security reviews, heightened Chinese regulatory scrutiny, and shareholder concerns over conflicts of interest, voting rights and capital allocation.

Moreover, Starship, autonomous taxis, humanoid robots, AI data centers, mobile communications and orbital compute facilities are all capital‑intensive, technically demanding projects. Consolidating them under one roof does not eliminate technical risk; it merely concentrates those risks within a single corporate structure.

In revenue terms, analysts project SpaceX could see quarterly revenue exceed $50 billion by the end of 2027, nearly nine times its Q3 2025 level of $5.6 billion. Whether that forecast materializes will depend on sustained AI‑compute demand and SpaceX’s ability to turn chip, power, satellite and data‑center builds into stable commercial revenue streams.

Musk’s core ambition in building a tech empire is no longer just about cheaper electric cars or more rockets, but about integrating the most critical infrastructure of the AI era. From Starlink’s global communications and SpaceX’s compute and self‑built power to Tesla’s vehicles, factories and robots, the plan seeks to create a full‑stack technology ecosystem that stretches from space to the ground. Yet alongside rapid revenue growth, massive capex, financing needs and a suite of high‑risk technical programs will determine whether this long‑term investment can succeed.

items.title: AI基建風暴升溫！新雲端業者全線重挫、信用風險攀升、Solidigm撤回IPO
items.title_en: AI Infrastructure Storm Intensifies! New Cloud Players Plunge, Credit Risks Rise, Solidigm Pulls IPO
paras: AI基礎建設投資本週經歷動盪的一週。《CNBC》報導，新型雲端業者（Neocloud）股價重挫，信用違約交換（CDS）利差飆升，Meta(META-US)自由現金流轉為負值，南韓SK海力士(SK Hynix)旗下Solidigm也取消IPO計畫。
那斯達克指數週四遭遇重挫後，週五(23日)進一步下跌，整週收低0.7%。在超大規模雲端服務商（Hyperscalers）之中，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)表現最差，股價下跌6%，市場正等待這家網路巨頭下週公布第三季財報。微軟(MSFT-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)也將公布財報，兩家公司股價則各自下跌不到1%。
儘管科技股市場迄今尚未出現全面性大規模拋售，AI基礎建設投資熱潮卻已開始顯露壓力。
新雲端業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、Nebius(NBIS-US)及IREN(IREN-US)本週全線重挫，10月以來跌幅均已遠超過30%。其中，規模領先的CoreWeave，其CDS利差已擴大至11%以上，通常被視為陷入財務困境的警訊，反映投資人為防範違約風險而必須支付更高成本。CoreWeave於2031年及2032年到期的無擔保債券殖利率也突破15%。
Roundhill Investments執行長Dave Mazza週四受訪表示，「投資人現在的做法，是把所有人都一併打入冷宮，認為任何新雲端業者都將遭到重新估值、股價下修。」
市場疑慮也不僅限於美國。南韓雲端服務商Elice Group週二上市首日股價下跌30%，澳洲資料中心營運商NextDC(NXT-AU)週三暴跌39.5%，因公司大幅下修全年獲利預測。
過去幾年，市場對AI的樂觀情緒一直是推動股市的重要力量。隨著市場對新模型與AI服務的需求持續攀升，全球最大型科技公司以歷史罕見規模投入基礎建設。然而，愈來愈多懷疑論者開始質疑，AI投資的回報是否足以支撐龐大的資本支出。
研究機構Gartner分析師預測，到2030年，80%新型雲端業者將停止營運，或被其他公司併購。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳或許是AI最積極支持者之一，他仍對產業前景保持樂觀。黃仁勳本週在柏林舉行的GTC大會中表示，「市場對新型雲端業者的需求高得驚人」。
黃仁勳接受CNBC訪問時談到，「資金需求遠遠超過目前可取得的資金規模，這個問題終究會獲得解決。」

Solidigm撤回IPO計畫

華爾街對AI投資熱潮的信心卻沒有那麼堅定。南韓記憶體大廠SK海力士(SKHY-US)是AI熱潮主要受惠者之一，但公司週四宣布，因市場波動而撤回旗下美國子公司Solidigm的IPO計畫。Solidigm主要為資料中心生產NAND快閃記憶體與固態硬碟（SSD），SK海力士於2021年向英特爾(INTC-US)收購該業務。
SK海力士在聲明中表示，「原本預期透過IPO減輕投資負擔，並擴大股東報酬能力，但考量市場狀況與股價走勢後，公司決定停止相關評估。」
儘管市場動盪，科技業大型權值股目前仍維持投資級信用評等，即使它們為了推進AI基礎建設而大舉投入資金，並透過發債等方式籌措資金，市場仍開始出現不安情緒。
Meta第三季自由現金流轉負，金額超過20億美元。公司同時將全年資本支出預測下限從1,300億美元提高至1,350億美元，導致股價週四重挫7%。Meta還表示，未來數年在各類租賃與合約上的支出約達8,250億美元，其中逾4,500億美元的租賃合約屬於不可取消的「照付不議」（take-or-pay）協議。
Meta五年期CDS利差升至歷史新高，突破124個基點。輝達與甲骨文(ORCL-US)的CDS利差本週也創下紀錄，分別達到126個基點與343個基點。甲骨文今年已下跌超過三分之一，如今還面臨信用評等遭下調的風險。
律師事務所Milbank LLP衍生性金融商品業務主管John Williams表示，投資人正尋求多種風險避險方式，不再只是透過買進CDS來降低AI投資曝險。
Williams指出，「投入這個領域的資金實在太多了，因此尋找風險管理工具非常合理，無論你看多還是看空都一樣。不去尋找合適的風險管理工具，反而不明智。」
Equity Armor Investments投資組合經理人Brian Stutland上週受訪時，談到AI對整體市場的影響，表示各環節「其實全都環環相扣」。
他指出，「你能把一顆保齡球丟進泳池的一端，卻確保下游的那斯達克其他部分完全不會受到波及嗎？我不知道，但這確實讓我有些擔憂。」
paras_en: AI infrastructure investments experienced a turbulent week. CNBC reported that new cloud provider Neocloud saw its stock tumble, credit default swap (CDS) spreads surge, Meta (META-US) turned its free cash flow negative, and SK Hynix's Solidigm in South Korea cancelled its IPO plan.

After the Nasdaq index suffered a sharp drop on Thursday, it fell further on Friday (the 23rd), closing the week down 0.7%. Among the hyperscalers, Alphabet (GOOGL-US) performed the worst, sliding 6% as the market awaits the internet giant’s Q3 earnings next week. Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Amazon (AMZN-US) also have earnings due, with their shares each slipping less than 1%.
Although the tech‑stock market has not yet seen a broad, massive sell‑off, the AI infrastructure investment boom is already showing signs of strain.

New cloud players CoreWeave (CRWV-US), Nebius (NBIS-US) and IREN (IREN-US) all plunged this week, each down more than 30% since October. The leading CoreWeave saw its CDS spread widen to over 11%, a typical warning sign of financial distress, reflecting investors’ need to pay higher costs to hedge default risk. CoreWeave’s unsecured bonds maturing in 2031 and 2032 also saw yields break 15%.

Roundhill Investments CEO Dave Mazza told reporters on Thursday that “investors are now treating everyone the same, shoving all new cloud players into the cold aisle, assuming they will all be re‑valuated and see their stock prices cut.”

Market concerns are not limited to the United States. South Korean cloud provider Elice Group saw its shares fall 30% on the first day of trading on Tuesday, while Australian data‑center operator NextDC (NXT-AU) plunged 39.5% on Wednesday after the company sharply cut its full‑year profit outlook.

In recent years, optimism about AI has been a key driver of equity markets. As demand for new models and AI services keeps climbing, the world’s largest tech firms are investing in infrastructure at historically unprecedented scales. Yet an increasing number of skeptics are questioning whether AI returns can justify the massive capital outlays.
Gartner analysts forecast that by 2030, 80% of new cloud providers will either cease operations or be acquired by other companies.

Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang may be one of AI’s most vocal champions, and he remains upbeat about the industry’s prospects. Huang said at the GTC conference in Berlin this week that “the market’s demand for new cloud providers is astonishingly high.”
In a CNBC interview, Huang added, “Funding needs far exceed the amount of capital currently available; this problem will eventually be solved.”

Solidigm Pulls IPO Plan
Wall Street’s confidence in the AI investment frenzy is less firm. South Korean memory giant SK Hynix (SKHY-US), a major beneficiary of the AI boom, announced on Thursday that it is withdrawing the IPO plan for its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm due to market volatility. Solidigm manufactures NAND flash memory and SSDs for data centers; SK Hynix acquired the business from Intel (INTC-US) in 2021.

In its statement, SK Hynix said, “We originally expected the IPO to ease investment burdens and expand shareholder returns, but after considering market conditions and stock performance, the company has decided to halt the evaluation.”

Despite the market turbulence, large‑cap tech stocks still retain investment‑grade credit ratings. Even as they pour massive capital into AI infrastructure and raise funds through bond issuances, market unease is beginning to surface.

Meta’s Q3 free cash flow turned negative, exceeding $2 billion. The company also raised the lower end of its full‑year capital‑expenditure forecast from $130 billion to $135 billion, sending the stock down 7% on Thursday. Meta also disclosed that over the next few years it expects about $825 billion in lease and contract spend, more than $450 billion of which are non‑cancellable take‑or‑pay agreements.

Meta’s five‑year CDS spread hit a historic high, breaking 124 basis points. Nvidia’s and Oracle’s (ORCL-US) CDS spreads also set weekly records at 126 and 343 basis points respectively. Oracle has already fallen more than a third this year and now faces the risk of a credit‑rating downgrade.
Milbank LLP derivatives head John Williams said investors are seeking multiple hedging strategies, no longer relying solely on buying CDS to reduce AI‑investment exposure.

Williams noted, “The amount of capital flowing into this sector is enormous, so looking for risk‑management tools is entirely reasonable, whether you’re bullish or bearish. Not seeking appropriate risk‑mitigation tools would be unwise.”
Brian Stutland, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, said in an interview last week that the impact of AI on the overall market is “really interconnected at every link.”
He added, “Can you throw a bowling ball into one end of a swimming pool and be sure the downstream parts of the Nasdaq won’t be affected? I don’t know, but it does worry me.”

items.title: 美特使稱最快週末攻擊伊朗 以色列宣布封鎖西岸、中東多線升溫
items.title_en: US Envoy Says Attack on Iran Possible This Weekend; Israel Announces West Bank Blockade, Middle East Tensions Rise
paras: 美國最快本週末再度攻擊伊朗？美國駐土耳其大使、兼任總統敘利亞及伊拉克特使的巴拉克 (Tom Barrack) 表示，美方「絕對有可能」在本週末發動攻擊。不過，美國總統川普週五 (23 日) 被問及這番說法時，卻表示自己毫不知情，讓華府下一步軍事動向更受關注。
巴拉克在週五於網路流傳的專訪片段中，被問到美方是否可能在本週末攻擊伊朗時，回答：「本週末有可能發動攻擊嗎？絕對有可能。」
巴拉克強調，川普政府對伊朗的目標並非推翻政權，而是降低區域與國際安全威脅。川普希望重新調整局勢，化解人質問題、消除威脅，讓全球局勢恢復平靜。
他也指出，川普仍願意與德黑蘭達成協議，對協商抱持開放態度，「但他同時也非常清楚地表明自己想要什麼」。
記者隨後向川普詢問巴拉克的說法，並追問他是否改變原先等到 11 月 3 日期中選舉後才考慮動武的立場。
川普一開始似乎感到意外，反問：「那是我的大使說的？」
川普接著說：「看來他是個相當有權勢的人。嗯，如果是這樣，我對此一無所知。」他並未證實美方是否準備在週末採取軍事行動。
然而，川普週五在佛羅里達州造勢時，也未排除再次攻擊伊朗，同時表示美國「可能再來一次小規模的『史詩怒火』行動」，但未進一步說明。「史詩怒火」是美軍對伊朗軍事行動使用的名稱。
面對美方可能再度動武，伊朗革命衛隊政治局負責人賈瓦尼 (Yadollah Javani) 則發出警告。
他表示，若外國部隊發動地面入侵，伊朗將成為入侵者的「墳場」，並聲稱美軍在區域內已面臨部署限制，難以進入陌生地形並維持駐軍。
美伊戰爭自 2 月底爆發至今已近 8 個月，荷姆茲海峽成為雙方角力焦點。
伊朗攻擊船舶與能源設施，加上美國封鎖伊朗港口，已干擾全球油氣供應；燃料價格上漲，也在美國期中選舉前加重川普的政治壓力。
與此同時，中東其他戰線持續升溫。約旦河西岸希伯崙週五發生槍戰，以軍表示，2 名以色列士兵死亡、3 人受傷，2 名巴勒斯坦槍手隨後遭擊斃。
以色列總理尼坦雅胡宣布將全面封鎖西岸，並稱以軍已準備展開「大規模行動」。
以軍稍後則表示，已在巴勒斯坦希伯崙地區展開範圍有限、具針對性的安全行動，預計持續數日。當地多處道路及出入口遭封閉，學校、大學停課，交通服務暫停。
葉門方面，沙烏地阿拉伯領導的聯軍表示，已攔截青年運動 (胡塞組織) 朝沙國南部城市海米斯穆謝特發射的一枚彈道飛彈。沙國支持的葉門政府軍也聲稱，已空襲塔伊茲一處胡塞組織指揮據點。
為避免衝突進一步擴大，埃及、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其及巴基斯坦外長在伊斯坦堡會談後發表聯合聲明，強調應透過對話與外交處理美國、以色列對伊朗的戰爭，反對限制合法航行的措施，並呼籲全面恢復荷姆茲海峽安全通航。
paras_en: US may attack Iran again as early as this weekend? Tom Barrack, the US ambassador to Turkey who also serves as President’s special envoy to Syria and Iraq, said the US "absolutely could" launch an attack this weekend. However, when asked about the remark on Friday the 23rd, President Trump said he was unaware, drawing even more attention to Washington’s next military move.

In a widely circulated online interview clip on Friday, Barrack was asked whether the US might attack Iran this weekend, to which he replied, "Is an attack possible this weekend? Absolutely possible."

Barrack emphasized that the Trump administration’s goal toward Iran is not regime change but reducing regional and global security threats. Trump wants to reset the situation, resolve hostage issues, eliminate threats, and restore global stability.
He also noted that Trump remains willing to reach an agreement with Tehran and is open to negotiations, "but he also makes very clear what he wants."
Reporters then asked Trump about Barrack’s statement and whether he had changed his earlier stance of waiting until after the November 3 midterm elections before considering military action.
Trump initially seemed surprised and asked, "Did my ambassador say that?"
Trump went on, "He seems to be a very powerful person. Well, if that’s the case, I know nothing about it." He did not confirm whether the US was preparing a weekend military operation.

Nevertheless, Trump did not rule out another strike on Iran while campaigning in Florida on Friday, saying the US could launch another small‑scale "Epic Fury" operation, but gave no further details. "Epic Fury" is the name the US military uses for actions against Iran.
In response to the possibility of renewed US force, Iran’s Revolutionary Guard political bureau chief Yadollah Javani issued a warning.

He said that if foreign forces launch a ground invasion, Iran would become a "graveyard" for the invaders, and claimed US forces in the region face deployment limits, making it hard to operate in unfamiliar terrain and maintain a presence.
The US‑Iran war, which erupted at the end of February, has now lasted nearly eight months, with the Strait of Hormuz becoming the focal point of the contest.

Iran’s attacks on ships and energy facilities, combined with US blockades of Iranian ports, have disrupted global oil and gas supplies; rising fuel prices are adding political pressure on Trump ahead of the midterm elections.

Meanwhile, other fronts in the Middle East continue to heat up. A gunfight broke out in Hebron in the West Bank on Friday, with the Israeli army reporting two Israeli soldiers killed, three wounded, and two Palestinian gunmen later killed.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced a total blockade of the West Bank, saying the Israeli forces are ready to launch a "large‑scale operation."

The Israeli army later said it had begun a limited, targeted security operation in the Hebron area of the Palestinian territories, expected to last several days. Multiple roads and entry points were closed, schools and universities suspended classes, and transport services were halted.

In Yemen, the Saudi‑led coalition said it intercepted a ballistic missile launched by the Houthi movement toward the southern Yemeni city of Hami‑Smuchet. Yemen’s government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, also claimed to have air‑striked a Houthi command post in Taiz.

To prevent further escalation, the foreign ministers of Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan issued a joint statement after meeting in Istanbul, emphasizing that the US‑Israel war against Iran should be addressed through dialogue and diplomacy, opposing measures that restrict lawful navigation, and calling for the full restoration of safe shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: 標普逼近歷史高點60%成分股卻陷熊市？SPY是否掩蓋更大問題？
items.title_en: S&P Near Historic Highs Yet 60% of Its Components Stuck in a Bear Market? Does SPY Mask a Bigger Issue?
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，標普500指數徘徊在歷史高點附近，但市場表面之下的疲弱態勢，正引發外界對華爾街這波漲勢能否持續的疑問。
根據 The Kobeissi Letter 分析，標普500指數有59%成分股，股價較歷史高點下跌至少20%，另有84%成分股下跌至少10%。然而，自3月30日市場觸底以來，僅有10檔股票就貢獻了該指數70%的漲幅。
這種分歧凸顯出，漲勢集中在少數大型科技與半導體公司，可能掩蓋整體市場普遍疲弱的情況。
SPY與VOO：追蹤相同指數，投資曝險相近
SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY-US) 與 Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO-US) 都追蹤採市值加權的標普500指數。因此兩者報酬率通常走勢相近，市值最大的企業對基金績效具有最大的影響力。
兩者的主要差異在於費用。VOO的年費用率為0.03%，低於SPY約0.0945%的年費用率，因此，對於尋求長期布局標普500指數的投資人而言，VOO的成本較低。
這兩檔ETF都無法消除標普500指數本身的集中度風險。如果少數超大型股持續表現優異，即使許多成分股陷入困境，兩檔基金仍可能維持強勢。
如果市場領漲範圍擴大，RSP有望受惠？
Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP-US) 提供了另一種投資相同500家企業的方式。與SPY和VOO將較高比重配置給市值較大的公司不同，RSP讓每檔成分股的權重大致相同，並定期重新調整投資組合。
當市場漲勢集中在少數超大型股時，這項差異就格外重要。在SPY和VOO中，最大型企業的漲幅可以抵銷數十檔規模較小成分股的跌幅。RSP則降低了大型股的主導程度，讓表現較弱的企業對基金整體報酬產生更大的影響。
兩者的持股集中度差距相當顯著。輝達 (NVDA-US) 占SPY投資組合7.88%，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 占7.45%，微軟 (MSFT-US) 占5.94%。三檔股票合計占SPY投資組合超過21%。RSP採取等權重配置方式，將單一成分股的權重限制在約0.2%至0.3%，實際比重則會隨市場變動而有所不同。
然而，近期績效尚未顯示等權重策略具明顯優勢。SPY今年以來上漲11.8%，RSP則上漲12.3%，兩者差距不大。
VOO提供的市值加權投資曝險幾乎與SPY相同，但年費用率較低。RSP的年費用率則為0.20%。以1萬美元的投資金額計算，三檔ETF每年費用分別約為3美元、9.45美元及20美元。
如果更多標普500成分股股價回升，並參與這波漲勢，RSP可能因此受惠。然而，如果大型科技股持續領漲，SPY和VOO的表現就可能優於RSP。此外，RSP採取等權重配置，也不代表它在市場全面下跌時必然更安全。
機會還是警訊？
市場廣度數據顯示，如果企業獲利與市場情緒改善，先前大幅下跌的股票可能迎來反彈。然而，股價大幅回檔並不代表股票必然被低估。
在將這場所謂的「隱形熊市」視為買進機會之前，投資人應關注企業獲利預期的修正、參與漲勢的成分股範圍，以及漲幅是否開始擴散至大型企業以外的股票。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that the S&P 500 index is hovering near historic highs, but a weak underlying market is raising doubts about whether Wall Street’s rally can be sustained.

According to analysis from The Kobeissi Letter, 59% of S&P 500 constituents are down at least 20% from their historic peaks, and 84% are down at least 10%. Yet since the market bottomed on March 30, only ten stocks have contributed about 70% of the index’s gain.
This divergence highlights that the rally is concentrated in a handful of large‑cap tech and semiconductor firms, potentially masking broader market weakness.
SPY and VOO: Tracking the Same Index, Similar Exposure

Both the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY-US) and the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO-US) track the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, so their returns usually move in tandem and the biggest companies have the greatest impact on fund performance.
The main difference lies in fees. VOO’s expense ratio is 0.03%, lower than SPY’s roughly 0.0945%, making VOO cheaper for investors seeking a long‑term S&P 500 position.
Both ETFs cannot eliminate the concentration risk inherent in the S&P 500. If a few mega‑caps keep outperforming while many components struggle, the funds can still look strong.
If the market’s rally breadth widens, could RSP benefit?

The Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF (RSP-US) offers a different way to invest in the same 500 companies. Unlike SPY and VOO, which give higher weight to larger caps, RSP assigns roughly equal weight to each constituent and rebalances regularly.

When the rally is driven by a few mega‑caps, this difference matters. In SPY and VOO, gains from the biggest firms can offset declines in dozens of smaller stocks. RSP reduces the dominance of large caps, allowing weaker performers to have a larger impact on overall returns.

The concentration gap is stark. Nvidia (NVDA-US) makes up 7.88% of SPY, Apple (AAPL-US) 7.45%, and Microsoft (MSFT-US) 5.94%—together over 21% of the fund. RSP’s equal‑weight approach caps any single stock at about 0.2‑0.3%, with actual weights varying as the market moves.
However, recent performance has not shown a clear edge for the equal‑weight strategy. So far this year SPY is up 11.8% and RSP 12.3%, a modest difference.

VOO’s market‑cap exposure is almost identical to SPY’s but its expense ratio is lower. RSP’s expense ratio is 0.20%. On a $10,000 investment, the annual fees are roughly $3 for VOO, $9.45 for SPY, and $20 for RSP.

If more S&P 500 constituents recover and join the rally, RSP could benefit. Conversely, if large‑cap tech continues to lead, SPY and VOO may outperform RSP. Also, equal weighting does not guarantee safety in a broad market decline.
Opportunity or warning?

Market breadth data suggest that if corporate earnings and sentiment improve, stocks that have fallen sharply could rebound. Yet a sharp price bounce does not automatically mean a stock is undervalued.

Before treating this so‑called “hidden bear market” as a buying opportunity, investors should watch for revisions to earnings expectations, the range of stocks participating in the rally, and whether gains are spreading beyond the biggest companies.

items.title: 三星德州廠加碼2奈米設備！2027年下半年月產能可望達2萬片
items.title_en: Samsung Expands Texas Plant with Additional 2nm Equipment; Monthly Capacity Expected to Reach 20,000 Wafers in Late 2027
paras: 三星電子持續擴大美國先進製程布局，據《ZDNet Korea》週五 (23 日) 引述業界消息報導，三星已為德州泰勒第一廠追加設備訂單，可支應每月約 6,000 片的 2 奈米晶圓產能。連同先前設備投資及早期試產線，該廠預計於 2027 年下半年具備每月 2 萬片產能，達到設計上限。
報導指出，三星自 2025 年底起，便已投入可支應月產 1 萬片晶圓的設備投資。本次追加採購則是為了填滿第一廠剩餘的閒置空間，待相關設備投資完成，該廠核心設備布局也將進入收尾階段。
一名半導體業界人士表示，三星近期已開始下單，準備自今年底起追加導入設備，最快可於明年下半年開始帶動出貨量增加。這也意味著，設備導入、產能建置與實際出貨成長將分階段推進。
泰勒廠是三星在美國擴大先進晶片製造布局的重要據點。
三星於 2021 年決定投資興建，初期投資金額達 170 億美元，主要客戶包括特斯拉 (TSLA-US)。三星先前表示，第一廠以 2026 年開始營運為目標，後續將逐步擴充產能。
在製程技術方面，三星 2 奈米製程採用環繞式閘極 (GAA) 電晶體架構，其多橋通道場效電晶體 (MBCFET) 技術透過堆疊奈米片通道與環繞閘極設計，提升電流控制能力，以滿足先進晶片的效能與功耗需求。
隨著第一廠設備布局逐步到位，三星下一階段投資重點將轉向泰勒第二廠。
報導指出，三星計劃於今年底動工，目標於 2030 年開始營運，目前已要求多家半導體設備供應商提前取得設備導入所需的安全認證。
隨著人工智慧 (AI) 晶片對效能及能源效率的要求持續提高，2 奈米製程已成為先進晶圓代工競爭的重要戰場。
泰勒第一廠的擴產進度，以及第二廠的後續建設，將是三星推進美國先進製程布局的關鍵。
paras_en: Samsung Electronics continues to expand its advanced‑process footprint in the United States. According to ZDNet Korea on Friday the 23rd, Samsung has placed an additional equipment order for its Texas Taylor‑1 fab that can support about 6,000 2‑nanometer wafers per month. Combined with earlier equipment investments and an early pilot line, the plant is slated to achieve a monthly capacity of 20,000 wafers in the second half of 2027, reaching its design limit.

The report notes that Samsung began investing in equipment capable of producing 10,000 wafers per month at the end of 2025. This latest purchase is intended to fill the remaining idle space at the first plant; once the related equipment is installed, the core equipment layout at the site will move into its final stage.

A semiconductor industry insider said Samsung has recently started placing orders and plans to add more equipment from the end of this year, with the earliest shipments potentially boosting output as early as the second half of next year. This means equipment installation, capacity build‑out and actual shipment growth will proceed in phases.
The Taylor plant is a key site for Samsung’s expansion of advanced chip manufacturing in the United States.

Samsung decided in 2021 to invest in building the facility, with an initial outlay of $17 billion. Major customers include Tesla (TSLA‑US). Samsung previously said the first plant aims to start operations in 2026 and will gradually increase capacity thereafter.

In terms of process technology, Samsung’s 2‑nm node uses a gate‑all‑around (GAA) transistor architecture. Its multi‑bridge channel FET (MBCFET) technology stacks nanosheet channels with a surrounding gate to improve current control, meeting the performance and power‑efficiency demands of advanced chips.
As the equipment layout at the first plant comes online, Samsung’s next investment focus will shift to the Taylor‑2 facility.

The report states Samsung plans to break ground by the end of this year, targeting operation commencement in 2030, and has already asked multiple semiconductor equipment suppliers to obtain safety certifications needed for early equipment introduction.
With AI chips demanding ever‑higher performance and energy efficiency, the 2‑nm process has become a critical battleground in the advanced wafer‑foundry competition.
The expansion progress of Taylor‑1 and the subsequent construction of Taylor‑2 will be pivotal for Samsung’s push to solidify its advanced‑process presence in the United States.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。
交易員目前預估，日本銀行12月升息的機率為61%。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

items.title: 【遠東商銀】RBA立場鷹派，激勵澳幣上漲
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA’s Hawkish Stance Fuels Aussie Dollar Rise
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月獨棟住宅建設大幅下滑及未來建設指標建築許可降至三年半低點，並據多名伊朗官員表示有意拖延與美國談判，試圖削弱美國總統川普在11月期中選舉選情，而且美國公債收益率下滑，削減美元吸引力，週三令美元承壓；此外，路透調查顯示，多數經濟學家預計日本央行(BOJ)在12月上調利率至1.50%及維持每季升息一次的節奏，而且日本政府公布9月進、出口分別較上年同期增長18.9%和16.7%低於預期，但得益於半導體和人工智能(AI)相關產品需求強勁，出口連續十三個月實現增長，貿易逆差則縮窄至5,366億日圓，而且日本財務大臣片山皋月指出，進口成本上升推動日本經濟面臨物價上漲，且即將進入由工資上漲驅動的持續通貨膨脹時期，政府將與BOJ保持密切溝通，雙方在通貨膨脹前景與政策方面無重大分歧，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.39高點下滑。

隨著日本長期公債收益率延續漲勢，正吸引日本資本加劇回流，並據BOJ副總裁冰見野良三表示，燃料和原材料價格上漲推高物價，且全球AI需求旺盛對物價形成上行壓力，認為日本基礎通貨膨脹率已相當接近央行的2%目標，表明BOJ已準備好上調借貸成本，擴大美元兌日圓跌幅至157.82低點，但美國和以色列與伊朗之間的衝突加劇，市場波動性上升及引發對能源供應中斷的擔憂，而且美國原油燃料庫存下降提供額外支持，國際原油價格上漲，限制美元走低。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.20-40，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁豪澤昨日表示，貨幣緊縮正在使經濟放緩，但原油價格高企令通貨膨脹惡化，讓其不確定下個月是否需要進一步加息，目前市場預計RBA於11月加息的概率升至約50%，激勵澳幣漲至三周高點，帶動歐元兌美元自1.1211低點上漲。

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。

paras_en: The dollar fell on Wednesday (the 21st) as traders assessed renewed inflation risks from rising oil prices and waited for the Federal Reserve's meeting next week. The Australian dollar strengthened on tighter‑tone comments from central bank officials.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.

items.title: 英國財政預算案前夕 英鎊對歐元避險成本創5個月新高
items.title_en: Britain's Budget Looms as GBP/EUR Hedging Cost Hits Five-Month High
paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”
